<H3><SPAN id="The_Fast_and_the_Furious_.282001.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="The_Fast_and_the_Furious_(2001)"><I>The Fast and the Furious</I> (2001)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: The Fast and the Furious (2001)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious_(2001_film)" title="The Fast and the Furious (2001 film)">The Fast and the Furious (2001 film)</A></DIV>
<P>The film is based on an article, titled "Racer X", about New York street clubs that race Japanese cars late at night, although the film is set primarily in Los Angeles. While elite street racer and ex-convict <A href="/wiki/Dominic_Toretto" title="Dominic Toretto">Dominic Toretto</A> (<A href="/wiki/Vin_Diesel" title="Vin Diesel">Vin Diesel</A>) and his crew: Jesse (<A href="/wiki/Chad_Lindberg" title="Chad Lindberg">Chad Lindberg</A>), Leon (<A href="/wiki/Johnny_Strong" title="Johnny Strong">Johnny Strong</A>), Vince (<A href="/wiki/Matt_Schulze" title="Matt Schulze">Matt Schulze</A>) and Letty Ortiz (<A href="/wiki/Michelle_Rodriguez" title="Michelle Rodriguez">Michelle Rodriguez</A>), are under suspicion of stealing expensive electronic equipment by hijacking moving trucks, <A href="/wiki/Brian_O%27Conner" title="Brian O'Conner">Brian O'Conner</A> (<A href="/wiki/Paul_Walker" title="Paul Walker">Paul Walker</A>) is an undercover police officer who attempts to find out who exactly is stealing the equipment.  He works for FBI agent Bilkins (<A href="/wiki/Thom_Barry" title="Thom Barry">Thom Barry</A>) and LAPD Sgt. Tanner (<A href="/wiki/Ted_Levine" title="Ted Levine">Ted Levine</A>).
</P><P>Falling for Dominic's younger sister, Mia Toretto (<A href="/wiki/Jordana_Brewster" title="Jordana Brewster">Jordana Brewster</A>), Brian confesses to her his status as an undercover police officer and convinces her to come with him to save her brother and his friends from the truck drivers, who have now armed themselves to combat the robberies. He tracks Dominic's location by triangulating his cell phone signal and they arrive at the hijacking in progress to find Letty, badly injured in a car accident, and Vince critically wounded, having lacerated his arm and been shot by a truck driver. Brian and Mia work together with Dominic, Leon and Letty to rescue Vince. Brian then makes the difficult decision to blow his cover to the crew by phoning in for a medivac. The revelation enrages Dominic, who flees with Leon, Letty, and Mia as the medivac arrives for Vince.
</P><P>Brian soon follows Dominic to his house and holds him at gunpoint to prevent him from fleeing further. Jesse arrives shortly afterwards, apologizing for his actions at Race Wars and pleading for Dominic's help with Johnny Tran (<A href="/wiki/Rick_Yune" title="Rick Yune">Rick Yune</A>). Moments later, Tran and his cousin Lance Nguyen (<A href="/wiki/Reggie_Lee_(actor)" title="Reggie Lee (actor)">Reggie Lee</A>) perform a drive-by shooting, killing Jesse. Brian and Dominic chase them, with Dominic driving his late father's modified 1970 Dodge Charger. Dominic forces Lance's motorcycle off the road, severely injuring him, while Brian shoots and kills Tran. Afterwards, Brian and Dominic engage in an impromptu street race, narrowly avoiding a passing train. However, Dominic collides with a semitruck and rolls his car twice, injuring himself, and rendering the Charger undrivable. Instead  of arresting him, Brian hands over the keys to his Supra and lets Dominic escape, using the line "I owe you a ten-second car."
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="2_Fast_2_Furious_.282003.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="2_Fast_2_Furious_(2003)"><I>2 Fast 2 Furious</I> (2003)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: 2 Fast 2 Furious (2003)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/2_Fast_2_Furious" title="2 Fast 2 Furious">2 Fast 2 Furious</A></DIV>
<P>Watched by undercover Customs Agent Monica Fuentes (<A href="/wiki/Eva_Mendes" title="Eva Mendes">Eva Mendes</A>), Brian is caught by US Customs agents and given a deal by FBI Agent Bilkins and Customs Agent Markham (<A href="/wiki/James_Remar" title="James Remar">James Remar</A>) to go undercover and try to bring down drug lord Carter Verone (<A href="/wiki/Cole_Hauser" title="Cole Hauser">Cole Hauser</A>) in exchange for the erasure of his criminal record. Brian agrees but only if he is given permission to choose his partner, refusing to partner with the agent assigned to watch him. Brian heads home to Barstow, California, where he recruits Roman Pearce (<A href="/wiki/Tyrese_Gibson" title="Tyrese Gibson">Tyrese Gibson</A>), a childhood friend of Brian who had served jail time and is under house arrest, to help him. Pearce agrees, but only for the same deal Brian was offered, and with the help of Monica, Brian and Roman work together to take down Verone. After acquiring confiscated vehicles and being hired by Verone as his drivers, the duo return to a Customs/FBI hideout, where Roman confronts Markham over the latter's interference with the mission. After the situation is cooled down, Brian tells Bilkins and Markham that Verone plans to smuggle the money into his private jet and fly off, but also suspects something wrong with Monica's role in the mission.
</P><P>Later, Brian and Roman race two of Verone's drivers for their cars and begin to devise a personal back up plan if the operation goes awry. Roman confronts Brian about his attraction to Monica and the constant threat of Verone's men. On the day of the mission, Brian and Roman begin transporting duffel bags of Verone's money, with two of Verone's men Enrique (<A href="/wiki/Mo_Gallini" title="Mo Gallini">Mo Gallini</A>) and Roberto (Roberto Sanchez) riding along to watch Brian and Roman. Before the 15-minute window is set, the detective in charge, Whitworth (<A href="/wiki/Mark_Boone_Junior" title="Mark Boone Junior">Mark Boone Junior</A>), decides to call in the police to move in for the arrest, resulting in a high-speed chase across the city. The duo lead the police to a warehouse, where a scramble by dozens of street racers disorient the police. Following the scramble, police manage to pull over the Evo and the Eclipse, only to find out that they were driven by two members of Brian's new crew, friends, Tej Parker (<A href="/wiki/Ludacris" title="Ludacris">Ludacris</A>) and Suki (<A href="/wiki/Devon_Aoki" title="Devon Aoki">Devon Aoki</A>).
</P><P>As Brian approaches the destination point in a <A href="/wiki/Yenko_Camaro" title="Yenko Camaro">Yenko Camaro</A>, Enrique tells him to make a detour away from the airfield. Meanwhile, Roman gets rid of Roberto by using an improvised ejector seat in his (orange) <A href="/wiki/Dodge_Challenger" title="Dodge Challenger">Dodge Challenger</A> powered by nitrous oxide. At the airfield, Customs Agents have Verone's plane and convoy surrounded, only to discover they are duped into a decoy maneuver while Verone is at a boatyard several miles away. As he knew Monica was an undercover agent, he gave her the wrong information on the destination point and plans to use her as leverage. When Brian arrives at the intended drop-off point, Enrique prepares to kill him when Roman suddenly appears and the both of them dispatch Enrique. Verone makes his escape aboard his private yacht, but Brian and Roman use the Yenko Camaro and drive off a ramp, crashing on top of the yacht. The duo manage to apprehend Verone and save Monica.
</P><P>With their crimes pardoned, Brian and Roman ponder on what to do next other than to settle in Miami when the former mentions starting a garage. Roman asks how they would afford that and Brian reveals that he took some of the money, as Roman also reveals that his pockets aren't empty, having taken money for himself.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="The_Fast_and_the_Furious:_Tokyo_Drift_.282006.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="The_Fast_and_the_Furious:_Tokyo_Drift_(2006)"><I>The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift</I> (2006)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift (2006)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious:_Tokyo_Drift" title="The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift">The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift</A></DIV>
<P>This film's story occurs sometime after <I><A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_6" title="Fast & Furious 6">Fast & Furious 6</A></I> with a scene that was later made concurrent with events in <I><A href="/wiki/Furious_7" title="Furious 7">Furious 7</A></I>.
</P><P>After totaling his car in an illegal street race, Sean Boswell (<A href="/wiki/Lucas_Black" title="Lucas Black">Lucas Black</A>) is sent to live in Tokyo, Japan, with his father, a <A href="/wiki/United_States_Navy" title="United States Navy">U.S. Navy</A> officer, in order to avoid <A href="/wiki/Juvenile_detention" class="mw-redirect" title="Juvenile detention">juvenile detention</A> or even jail.
</P><P>While in school, he befriends Twinkie (<A href="/wiki/Bow_Wow_(rapper)" title="Bow Wow (rapper)">Bow Wow</A>), a "military brat" who introduces him to the world of <A href="/wiki/Drifting_(motorsport)" title="Drifting (motorsport)">drift racing</A> in Japan. Though forbidden to drive, he decides to race against Takashi (<A href="/wiki/Brian_Tee" title="Brian Tee">Brian Tee</A>) aka D.K. (Drift King). He borrows a <A href="/wiki/Nissan_Silvia" title="Nissan Silvia">Nissan Silvia</A> from <A href="/wiki/Han_Lue" title="Han Lue">Han Lue</A> (<A href="/wiki/Sung_Kang" title="Sung Kang">Sung Kang</A>), now a business partner to Takashi, and loses, totaling the car because of his lack of knowledge of drifting. To repay his debt for the car he destroyed, Sean works for Han. Later on, Han becomes friends with Sean and teaches him how to drift.
</P><P>Takashi's uncle Kamata (<A href="/wiki/Sonny_Chiba" title="Sonny Chiba">Sonny Chiba</A>) (the head of the <A href="/wiki/Yakuza" title="Yakuza">Yakuza</A>) reprimands Takashi for allowing Han to steal from him. Takashi confronts Han, Sean and Neela (<A href="/wiki/Nathalie_Kelley" title="Nathalie Kelley">Nathalie Kelley</A>), and in doing so, they flee. During the chase, Han is killed in a car accident when his car catches fire. Takashi, Sean, and his father become involved in an armed standoff which is resolved by Neela agreeing to leave with Takashi. Twinkie gives his money to Sean to replace the money Han stole, which Sean then returns to Kamata.
</P><P>Sean proposes a race against Takashi to determine who must leave Tokyo. Sean and Han's friends then build a 1967 <A href="/wiki/Ford_Mustang" title="Ford Mustang">Ford Mustang</A>, with an inline-6 engine and other parts salvaged from Han's Silvia that Sean had destroyed. Sean wins the race and is later challenged by Dominic Toretto.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Fast_.26_Furious_.282009.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Fast_&_Furious_(2009)"><I>Fast & Furious</I> (2009)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: Fast & Furious (2009)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_(2009_film)" title="Fast & Furious (2009 film)">Fast & Furious (2009 film)</A></DIV>
<P><I>Fast & Furious</I>, as well as its succeeding films, takes place before the events of <I>The Fast and The Furious: Tokyo Drift</I>.
</P><P>About five years after <A href="/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious_(2001_film)" title="The Fast and the Furious (2001 film)">the events of the first film</A>, Dominic and his new crew (Letty, Han, Leo, Santos and Cara) have been hijacking <A href="/wiki/Tank_truck" title="Tank truck">fuel tankers</A> in the Dominican Republic. When their trail gets too hot, Dominic disbands the crew. However, he is later informed that Letty has been murdered. Dominic returns to Los Angeles where he finds traces of <A href="/wiki/Nitromethane" title="Nitromethane">nitro-methane</A> at the crash site, and tracks the buyer of the gas to David Park. Meanwhile, Brian O'Conner, who has been working as an <A href="/wiki/Federal_Bureau_of_Investigation" title="Federal Bureau of Investigation">FBI</A> agent, is tracking down a drug trafficker named <A href="/wiki/List_of_The_Fast_and_the_Furious_characters#Arturo_Braga" title="List of The Fast and the Furious characters">Arturo Braga</A>. When Brian and Dominic cross paths at David Park's apartment, Dominic is about to drop David out the window. But Brian intervenes, and works a scheme where he enters a street race where the winner would join Braga's team of drivers. Although Dominic wins the four-car race by bumping Brian's car, Brian later joins the team by replacing one of Braga's other drivers.
</P><P>The team meets <A href="/wiki/List_of_The_Fast_and_the_Furious_characters#Fenix_Calderon" title="List of The Fast and the Furious characters">Fenix Calderon</A> (<A href="/wiki/Laz_Alonso" title="Laz Alonso">Laz Alonso</A>) who directs them to drive the heroin across the border using underground tunnels to avoid detection. Brian realizes that the drivers are to be killed following the mission, and when Fenix reveals to Dominic that he killed Letty, Dominic detonates the nitrous in his car, blowing up a bunch of vehicles. In the chaos, Brian hijacks the <A href="/wiki/Hummer" title="Hummer">Hummer</A> that is carrying the heroin. Dominic and Brian drive back to Los Angeles, hiding the heroin in an impound lot. When Dominic learns Brian was the last person to contact Letty, he attacks him until Brian reveals that Letty was working undercover for Brian, tracking down Braga in exchange for clearing Dominic's name. Brian negotiates with the agency to free Dominic if they can lure Braga into personally coming to exchange the heroin for cash. However, at the drop site, it is revealed that the Braga they arrested was a decoy, and that the real Braga (<A href="/wiki/John_Ortiz" title="John Ortiz">John Ortiz</A>) has escaped, fleeing to Mexico.
</P><P>Suspended from duty, Brian joins Dominic to go to Mexico and in hopes of catching Braga. Although Braga agreeably surrenders, they are pursued by Braga's men through town and then the tunnels. Fenix T-bones Brian's car right outside the tunnel exit, but before he can kill Brian, Dominic drives into and kills Fenix. As the police arrive, Dominic refuses to escape, saying he is tired of running. Despite Brian's request for <A href="/wiki/Clemency" class="mw-redirect" title="Clemency">clemency</A>, the judge sentences Dominic to <A href="/wiki/Life_imprisonment" title="Life imprisonment">25 years to life</A>. During the prison bus ride to <A href="/wiki/Federal_Correctional_Institution,_Lompoc" title="Federal Correctional Institution, Lompoc">Lompoc penitentiary</A>, Brian and Mia, along with Leo and Santos, arrive in their cars and intercept the bus.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Fast_Five_.282011.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Fast_Five_(2011)"><I>Fast Five</I> (2011)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: Fast Five (2011)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Fast_Five" title="Fast Five">Fast Five</A></DIV>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable relarticle mainarticle selfreference noprint">This section is <A href="/wiki/Transclusion" title="Transclusion">transcluded</A> from <A href="/wiki/Fast_Five" title="Fast Five">Fast Five</A>. <SPAN class="plainlinks" style="font-style: normal"><SPAN style="font-size:85%;">(<A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fast_Five&action=edit">edit</A> | <A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fast_Five&action=history">history</A>)</SPAN></SPAN></DIV>
<P>When Dominic "Dom" Toretto is being transported to <A href="/wiki/Federal_Correctional_Institution,_Lompoc" title="Federal Correctional Institution, Lompoc">Lompoc Prison</A> by bus, his sister Mia Toretto and friend Brian O'Conner lead an assault on the bus, causing it to crash and freeing Dom. While the authorities search for them, the trio escapes to <A href="/wiki/Rio_de_Janeiro" title="Rio de Janeiro">Rio de Janeiro</A>. Awaiting Dom's arrival, Mia and Brian join their friend Vince and other participants on a job to steal three cars from a train. Brian and Mia discover that agents from the <A href="/wiki/Drug_Enforcement_Administration" title="Drug Enforcement Administration">U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)</A> are also on the train and that the cars are seized property. When Dom arrives with the rest of the participants, he realizes that the lead participant, Zizi, is only interested in stealing one car - a <A href="/wiki/Ford_GT40" title="Ford GT40">Ford GT40</A>. Dom has Mia steal the car herself before he and Brian fight Zizi and his henchmen, during which Zizi kills the DEA agents assigned to the vehicles. Dom and Brian are captured and brought to crime lord Hernan Reyes, the owner of the cars and Zizi's boss. Reyes orders the pair be interrogated to discover the location of the car, but they manage to escape and retreat to their safehouse.
</P><P>While Brian, Dom, and Mia examine the car to discover its importance, Vince arrives and is caught trying to remove a computer chip from it. He admits he was planning to sell the chip to Reyes on his own, and Dom forces him to leave. Brian investigates the chip and discovers it contains the complete financial details of Reyes' criminal empire, including the locations of US$100 million in cash.
</P><P><A href="/wiki/Diplomatic_Security_Service" title="Diplomatic Security Service">Diplomatic Security Service</A> agent Luke Hobbs and his team arrive in Rio to arrest Dom and Brian. With the help of local officer Elena Neves, they travel to Dom's safehouse, but find it under assault by Reyes' men. Brian, Dom and Mia escape; Dom suggests they split up and leave Rio, but Mia announces she is pregnant with Brian's child. Dom agrees to stick together and suggests they steal the money from Reyes to start a new life. They organize a team to perform the heist: Han, Roman, Tej, Gisele, Leo, and Santos. Vince later joins the team after saving Mia from being captured by Reyes' men.
</P><P>Hobbs and his team eventually find and arrest Dom, Mia, Brian, and Vince. While transporting them to the airport for <A href="/wiki/Extradition" title="Extradition">extradition</A> to the United States, the convoy is attacked by Reyes' men, who kill Hobbs' team. Hobbs and Elena are saved by Dom, Brian, Mia, and Vince as they fight back and escape, but Vince is shot in the process and dies. Wanting to avenge his murdered team, Hobbs and Elena agree to help with the heist. The gang break into the police station and tear the vault holding Reyes' money from the building using their cars, dragging it through the city. After an extensive police chase, Dom makes Brian continue without him while he attacks the police and the pursuing Reyes, using the vault attached to his car to smash their vehicles. Brian returns and kills Zizi while Reyes is badly injured by Dom's assault. Hobbs arrives on the scene and executes Reyes to avenge his team. Though Hobbs refuses to let Dom and Brian go free, he gives them a 24-hour head start to escape on the condition they leave the vault as it is. However, the vault is empty as it had been switched during the chase. After splitting the cash (Vince's share is given to his family), they go their separate ways.
</P><P>On a tropical beach, Brian and a visibly pregnant Mia relax. They are met by Dom and Elena. Brian challenges Dom to a final, no-stakes race to prove who is the better driver.
</P><P>In a <A href="/wiki/Mid-credits_scene" class="mw-redirect" title="Mid-credits scene">mid-credits scene</A>, Hobbs is given a file by Monica Fuentes concerning the <A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_6" title="Fast & Furious 6">hijack of a military convoy</A> in <A href="/wiki/Berlin" title="Berlin">Berlin</A>, where he discovers a recent photo of Dom's former girlfriend Letty, who had been presumed dead.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Fast_.26_Furious_6_.282013.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Fast_&_Furious_6_(2013)"><I>Fast & Furious 6</I> (2013)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: Fast & Furious 6 (2013)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_6" title="Fast & Furious 6">Fast & Furious 6</A></DIV>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable relarticle mainarticle selfreference noprint">This section is <A href="/wiki/Transclusion" title="Transclusion">transcluded</A> from <A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_6" title="Fast & Furious 6">Fast & Furious 6</A>. <SPAN class="plainlinks" style="font-style: normal"><SPAN style="font-size:85%;">(<A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fast_%26_Furious_6&action=edit">edit</A> | <A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Fast_%26_Furious_6&action=history">history</A>)</SPAN></SPAN></DIV>
<P>Following their <A href="/wiki/Fast_Five" title="Fast Five">successful heist in Brazil</A>, Dominic "Dom" Toretto and his professional criminal crew have fled around the world: Dom lives with Elena; his sister Mia lives with Brian O'Conner and their son, Jack; Gisele and Han live together; and Roman and Tej live in luxury. Meanwhile, <A href="/wiki/Diplomatic_Security_Service" title="Diplomatic Security Service">DSS</A> agent Luke Hobbs and Riley Hicks investigate the destruction of a Russian military convoy by a crew led by former British <A href="/wiki/Special_Air_Service" title="Special Air Service">SAS</A> Major and special ops soldier Owen Shaw. Hobbs persuades Dom to help capture Shaw by showing him a photo of the supposedly long-dead Letty Ortiz, Dom's former lover. Dom and his crew accept the mission in exchange for their amnesty, allowing them to return to the United States.
</P><P>In London, Shaw's hideout is found, but this is revealed to be a trap, distracting them and the police while Shaw's crew performs a heist at an Interpol building. Shaw flees by car, detonating his hideout and disabling most of the police, leaving Dom, Brian, Tej, Han, Gisele, Hobbs, and Riley to pursue him. Letty arrives to help Shaw, shooting Dom without hesitation before escaping. Back at their headquarters, Hobbs tells Dom's crew that Shaw is stealing components to create a deadly device, intending to sell it to the highest bidder. Meanwhile, Shaw's investigation into the opposing crew reveals Letty's relationship with Dom, but she is revealed to be suffering from amnesia. Dominic's crew learns that Shaw is connected to a drug lord <A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious_(2009_film)" title="Fast & Furious (2009 film)">who was imprisoned by Brian</A>, Arturo Braga. Brian returns to Los Angeles as a prisoner to question Braga, who says Letty survived the explosion that seemingly killed her; Shaw took her in after discovering her amnesia. With FBI help, Brian is released from prison, regrouping with the team in London.
</P><P>Dom challenges Letty in a street racing competition; afterwards, he returns her cross necklace he had kept. After Letty leaves, Shaw offers Dom a chance to walk away, threatening to otherwise hurt his family, but Dom refuses. Tej tracks Shaw's next attack to a Spanish NATO base. Shaw's crew assaults a highway military convoy carrying a computer chip to complete his deadly device. Dom's crew interferes while Shaw, accompanied by Letty, commandeers a tank, destroying cars en route. Brian and Roman manage to flip the tank before it causes further damage, resulting in Letty being thrown from the vehicle and Dom risking his life to save her. Shaw and his crew are captured, but reveal Mia has been kidnapped by Shaw. Hobbs is forced to release Shaw, and Riley, revealed to be Shaw's covert accomplice, leaves with him; Letty chooses to remain with Dom.
</P><P>Shaw's group board a large moving aircraft on a runway as Dom's crew gives chase. Dom, Letty, and Brian board the craft; Brian rescues Mia, escaping in an onboard car. The plane attempts take-off, but is held down by excess weight as the rest of the team tether the plane to their vehicles. Gisele sacrifices herself to save Han from Shaw's henchman; Letty kills Riley and escapes to safety, but Dom pursues Shaw and the computer chip. As the plane crashes into the ground, Shaw is thrown from it, seriously injuring him, and Dom drives a car out of the exploding plane. Dom reunites with his crew, and gives the chip to Hobbs to secure their pardons. Dom and the others return to his old family home in Los Angeles. Hobbs and Elena, now working together, arrive to confirm the crew's freedom; Elena accepts that Dom loves Letty. As Roman says grace over the crew's meal, Dom asks Letty if the gathering feels familiar; she answers "no, but it feels like home."
</P><P>In a <A href="/wiki/Mid-credits_scene" class="mw-redirect" title="Mid-credits scene">mid-credits scene</A>, <A href="/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious:_Tokyo_Drift" title="The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift">which takes place in Tokyo</A>, Han is involved in a car chase when he is suddenly broadsided by an oncoming car. The driver walks away from the scene after leaving Letty's cross necklace by the crash, and calls Dom as Han's car fatally explodes, saying, "<A href="/wiki/Furious_7" title="Furious 7">You don't know me. You're about to</A>."
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Furious_7_.282015.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Furious_7_(2015)"><I>Furious 7</I> (2015)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: Furious 7 (2015)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Furious_7" title="Furious 7">Furious 7</A></DIV>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable relarticle mainarticle selfreference noprint">This section is <A href="/wiki/Transclusion" title="Transclusion">transcluded</A> from <A href="/wiki/Furious_7" title="Furious 7">Furious 7</A>. <SPAN class="plainlinks" style="font-style: normal"><SPAN style="font-size:85%;">(<A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Furious_7&action=edit">edit</A> | <A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Furious_7&action=history">history</A>)</SPAN></SPAN></DIV>
<P>After defeating Owen Shaw and his crew and securing amnesty for their past crimes,<SUP id="cite_ref-Timeline_3-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-Timeline-3">[N 1]</A></SUP> <A href="/wiki/Dominic_Toretto" title="Dominic Toretto">Dominic "Dom" Toretto</A>, <A href="/wiki/Brian_O%27Conner" title="Brian O'Conner">Brian O'Conner</A> and the rest of their team have returned to the United States to live normal lives again. Brian begins to accustom himself to life as a father, while Dom tries to help Letty Ortiz regain her memory. Meanwhile, Owen's older brother, Deckard Shaw, breaks into the secure hospital that the comatose Owen is being held in and swears vengeance against Dom and his team, before breaking into Luke Hobbs' <A href="/wiki/Diplomatic_Security_Service" title="Diplomatic Security Service">Diplomatic Security Service</A> (DSS) office to extract profiles of Dom's crew. After revealing his identity, Shaw engages Hobbs in a fight, and escapes when he detonates a bomb that severely injures Hobbs. Dom later learns from his sister Mia that she is pregnant again and convinces her to tell Brian. However, a bomb, disguised in a package sent from <A href="/wiki/Tokyo" title="Tokyo">Tokyo</A>, explodes and destroys the Toretto house just seconds after Han, a member of Dom's team, is killed by Shaw in Tokyo. Dom later visits Hobbs in a hospital, where he learns that Shaw is a rogue special forces assassin seeking to avenge his brother. Dom then travels to Tokyo to claim Han's body, and meets and races Sean Boswell, a friend of Han's who gives him personal items found at Han's crash site.
</P><P>Back at Han's funeral in <A href="/wiki/Los_Angeles" title="Los Angeles">Los Angeles</A>, Dom notices a car observing them, and after a chase, confronts its driver, who is revealed to be Shaw. Both prepare to fight, but Shaw flees when a covert ops team arrives and opens fire, led by <A href="/wiki/List_of_The_Fast_and_the_Furious_characters#Mr._Nobody" title="List of The Fast and the Furious characters">Mr. Nobody</A>. Nobody says that he will assist Dom in stopping Shaw if he helps him obtain God's Eye, a computer program that uses digital devices to track down a person, and save its creator, a hacker named Ramsey, from a mercenary named Mose Jakande. Dom, Brian, Letty, Roman Pearce, and Tej Parker then <A href="/wiki/Airdrop" title="Airdrop">airdrop</A> their cars over the <A href="/wiki/Caucasus_Mountains" title="Caucasus Mountains">Caucasus Mountains</A> in Azerbaijan, ambush Jakande's convoy, and rescue Ramsey. The team then heads to <A href="/wiki/Abu_Dhabi" title="Abu Dhabi">Abu Dhabi</A>, where a billionaire has acquired the flash drive containing God's Eye, and manages to steal it from the owner. With God's Eye near <A href="/wiki/Repeater" title="Repeater">telecommunications repeaters</A>, the team tracks down Shaw, who is waiting at a remote factory. Dom, Brian, Nobody and his team attempt to capture Shaw, but are ambushed by Jakande and his men and forced to flee while Jakande obtains God's Eye. At his own request, the injured Nobody is left behind to be evacuated by helicopter while Brian and Dom continue without him. To reduce their disadvantage, the crew returns to Los Angeles to fight Shaw, Jakande and his men. Meanwhile, Brian promises Mia that once they deal with Shaw, he will retire and fully dedicate himself to their family.
</P><P>While Jakande pursues Brian and the rest of the team with a <A href="/wiki/Stealth_helicopter" title="Stealth helicopter">stealth helicopter</A> and an <A href="/wiki/Unmanned_combat_aerial_vehicle" title="Unmanned combat aerial vehicle">aerial drone</A>, Ramsey attempts to hack into God's Eye. Hobbs, seeing the team in trouble, leaves the hospital and destroys the drone with an ambulance. Brian engages Jakande's henchman Kiet and throws him down an elevator shaft, allowing Ramsey to regain control of God's Eye and shut it down. Dom and Shaw engage in a one-on-one brawl on top of a public parking garage, before Jakande intervenes and attacks them both. Shaw is defeated when part of the parking garage collapses beneath him. Dom then launches his vehicle at Jakande's helicopter, tossing Shaw's bag of grenades onto its skids, before injuring himself when his car lands and crashes. Hobbs then shoots the bag of grenades from ground level, destroying the helicopter and killing Jakande. Dom is pulled from the wreckage of his car, believed to be dead. As Letty cradles Dom's body in her arms, she reveals that she has regained her memories, and that she remembers their wedding. Dom regains consciousness soon after, remarking, "It's about time".
</P><P>Shaw is taken into custody by Hobbs and locked away in a secret, high-security prison. At a beach, Brian and Mia play with their son while Dom, Letty, Roman, Tej, and Ramsey observe, acknowledging that Brian is better off retired with his family. Dom silently leaves, Ramsey asks if he's gonna say goodbye. Dom says, "It's never goodbye." He drives away, but Brian catches up with him at a crossroad. As Dom remembers the times that he had with Brian, they bid each other farewell and drive off <A href="/wiki/Missing_man_formation" title="Missing man formation">in separate directions</A>, as the screen fades to "For Paul" written on a white title screen.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="The_Fate_of_the_Furious_.282017.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="The_Fate_of_the_Furious_(2017)"><I>The Fate of the Furious</I> (2017)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section: The Fate of the Furious (2017)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/The_Fate_of_the_Furious" title="The Fate of the Furious">The Fate of the Furious</A></DIV>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable relarticle mainarticle selfreference noprint">This section is <A href="/wiki/Transclusion" title="Transclusion">transcluded</A> from <A href="/wiki/The_Fate_of_the_Furious" title="The Fate of the Furious">The Fate of the Furious</A>. <SPAN class="plainlinks" style="font-style: normal"><SPAN style="font-size:85%;">(<A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fate_of_the_Furious&action=edit">edit</A> | <A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fate_of_the_Furious&action=history">history</A>)</SPAN></SPAN></DIV>
<P><A href="/wiki/Dominic_Toretto" title="Dominic Toretto">Dominic "Dom" Toretto</A> and Letty Ortiz are on their honeymoon in <A href="/wiki/Havana" title="Havana">Havana</A> when Dom's cousin Fernando gets in trouble owing money to local racer Raldo. Sensing Raldo is a <A href="/wiki/Loan_shark" title="Loan shark">loan shark</A>, Dom challenges Raldo to a race, pitting Fernando's reworked car against Raldo's, and wagering his own <A href="/wiki/Show_car" title="Show car">show car</A>. After narrowly winning the race, Dom allows Raldo to keep his car, earning his respect, and instead leaves his cousin with his show car.
</P><P>The next day, Dom is approached by the elusive <A href="/wiki/Cyberterrorist" class="mw-redirect" title="Cyberterrorist">cyberterrorist</A> Cipher who coerces him into working for her. Shortly afterwards, Dom and his team, comprising Letty, Roman Pearce, Tej Parker, and Ramsey, are recruited by <A href="/wiki/Diplomatic_Security_Service" title="Diplomatic Security Service">Diplomatic Security Service</A> (DSS) agent Luke Hobbs to help him retrieve an <A href="/wiki/Electromagnetic_pulse" title="Electromagnetic pulse">EMP device</A> from a military outpost in <A href="/wiki/Berlin" title="Berlin">Berlin</A>. During the getaway, Dom goes rogue, forcing Hobbs off the road and stealing the device for Cipher. Hobbs is arrested and locked up in the same high-security prison he helped imprison Deckard Shaw in. After escaping, Deckard and Hobbs are recruited by intelligence operative Mr. Nobody and his protégé to help the team find Dom and capture Cipher. Deckard reveals that Cipher had hired his brother Owen Shaw to steal the Nightshade device and Mose Jakande to steal God's Eye, Ramsey's software program. The team tracks Dom and Cipher to their very location just as the latter two attack the base and steal God's Eye. When Dom questions Cipher's motives, she reveals that she has been holding hostage Dom's ex-lover and DSS agent Elena Neves—as well as their son, of whose existence Dom was previously unaware. Elena tells Dom that she wanted him to decide the child's first name, having already given him the middle name Marcos.
</P><P>In <A href="/wiki/New_York_City" title="New York City">New York City</A>, Cipher sends Dom to retrieve a <A href="/wiki/Nuclear_football" title="Nuclear football">nuclear football</A> held by the <A href="/wiki/Ministry_of_Defence_(Russia)" title="Ministry of Defence (Russia)">Russian Minister of Defence</A>. Prior to the theft, Dom briefly evades Cipher and persuades Deckard and Owen's mother, Magdalene Shaw, to help him. Cipher hacks into the electronics systems of a large number of cars, causing them to drive automatically and taking out the convoy so that Dom can take the football. The team intercepts Dom, but Dom escapes, shooting and apparently killing Deckard in the process. Letty catches up to Dom, but is ambushed and nearly killed by Cipher's enforcer, Connor Rhodes, before Dom rescues her. In retaliation, Cipher has Rhodes execute Elena in front of Dom.
</P><P>Dom infiltrates a base in Russia to use the EMP device to disable their security and then to disable a <A href="/wiki/Nuclear_submarine" title="Nuclear submarine">nuclear submarine</A>, enabling Cipher to hijack it and attempt to use its arsenal to trigger a nuclear war. They are once again intercepted by the team, who attempt to shut down the sub, and then drive out toward the gates that would prevent the sub from leaving into open waters. Meanwhile, Deckard, whose death was apparently faked, teams up with Owen, and under Magdalene's behest, infiltrates Cipher's plane to rescue Dom's son. Once Deckard reports that the child is safe, Dom turns on Cipher and kills Rhodes, avenging Elena's death, before rejoining his team. Outraged, Cipher fires an <A href="/wiki/Infrared_homing" title="Infrared homing">infrared homing missile</A> at Dom, but he breaks away from his team and maneuvers around it, causing the missile to hit the submarine instead. The team quickly forms a vehicular blockade around Dom, shielding him from the ensuing explosion. When Deckard reaches the front of the plane and confronts a defeated Cipher, she makes her escape by parachuting out of the plane.
</P><P>Mr. Nobody and his protégé visit Dom and his team in New York City to report that Cipher is still at large in <A href="/wiki/Athens" title="Athens">Athens</A>. Hobbs is offered his DSS job back, but he declines in order to spend more time with his daughter. Deckard delivers Dom his son, putting his differences aside with Dom and Hobbs. Dom names his son Brian, after his friend and brother-in-law <A href="/wiki/Brian_O%27Conner" title="Brian O'Conner">Brian O'Conner</A>, and they celebrate.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Hobbs_.26_Shaw_.282019.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Hobbs_&_Shaw_(2019)"><I>Hobbs & Shaw</I> (2019)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section: Hobbs & Shaw (2019)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Vin Diesel announced in an interview with <I>Variety</I> that potential spin-offs for the series were in the early stages of development.<SUP id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-4">[3]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-5">[4]</A></SUP> A spin-off film centered around two characters Luke Hobbs and Deckard Shaw has been announced by Universal and has a release date of July 26, 2019,<SUP id="cite_ref-whatculture.com_6-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-whatculture.com-6">[5]</A></SUP> with <I>Variety</I> reporting that <A href="/wiki/Shane_Black" title="Shane Black">Shane Black</A> is being considered to direct and Morgan returning to write the script.<SUP id="cite_ref-7" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-7">[6]</A></SUP> The announcement of the spin-off provoked a response on <A href="/wiki/Instagram" title="Instagram">Instagram</A> by <A href="/wiki/Tyrese_Gibson" title="Tyrese Gibson">Tyrese Gibson</A>, criticizing Johnson for causing the ninth <I>Fast & Furious</I> film to be delayed for another year.<SUP id="cite_ref-whatculture.com_6-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-whatculture.com-6">[5]</A></SUP>
</P><P>On October 23, 2017, Dwayne Johnson posted a video on Instagram which showed the finished script for the spin-off, titled <I>Hobbs and Shaw</I>. In February 2018, <A href="/wiki/David_Leitch_(director)" title="David Leitch (director)">David Leitch</A> entered talks to direct the film.<SUP id="cite_ref-8" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-8">[7]</A></SUP> In March 2018, it was reported that the film will start production in September 2018.<SUP id="cite_ref-9" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-9">[8]</A></SUP> On April 12, 2018, it was announced that Leitch would direct the film.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Future">Future</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section: Future">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>In February 2016, Diesel announced the ninth film and tenth film would be released on April 10, 2020,<SUP id="cite_ref-10" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-10">[9]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-11" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-11">[10]</A></SUP> and April 2, 2021, respectively, and that the tenth film would serve as the final film in the series.<SUP id="cite_ref-12" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-12">[11]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-13" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-13">[12]</A></SUP>
<A href="/wiki/Justin_Lin" title="Justin Lin">Justin Lin</A> is reportedly in line to direct the ninth installment.<SUP id="cite_ref-14" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-14">[13]</A></SUP> It was also announced that <A href="/wiki/Jordana_Brewster" title="Jordana Brewster">Jordana Brewster</A> would return for the ninth installment.
</P><P>In September of the same year, both Caleb and Cody Walker revealed to <I>Entertainment Tonight</I> that their brother's character may possibly return for another cameo in the franchise.<SUP id="cite_ref-15" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-15">[14]</A></SUP>
</P><P>On April 23, 2018, Universal and <A href="/wiki/DreamWorks_Animation" title="DreamWorks Animation">DreamWorks Animation</A> are creating an animated series based on the franchise and will be launched on <A href="/wiki/Netflix" title="Netflix">Netflix</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-16" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-16">[15]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Short_films">Short films</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=12" title="Edit section: Short films">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN id="The_Turbo_Charged_Prelude_for_2_Fast_2_Furious_.282003.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="The_Turbo_Charged_Prelude_for_2_Fast_2_Furious_(2003)"><I>The Turbo Charged Prelude for 2 Fast 2 Furious</I> (2003)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=13" title="Edit section: The Turbo Charged Prelude for 2 Fast 2 Furious (2003)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/The_Turbo_Charged_Prelude_for_2_Fast_2_Furious" title="The Turbo Charged Prelude for 2 Fast 2 Furious">The Turbo Charged Prelude for 2 Fast 2 Furious</A></DIV>
<P>The short film was included on a new print of the DVD of the first film in June 2003 to bridge the first two films.
</P><P>Brian O'Conner packs his bags and leaves Los Angeles, before the <A href="/wiki/LAPD" class="mw-redirect" title="LAPD">LAPD</A> gets a chance to arrest him for letting Dominic escape. While the FBI launch a national manhunt for him, Brian travels across <A href="/wiki/Arizona" title="Arizona">Arizona</A>, <A href="/wiki/New_Mexico" title="New Mexico">New Mexico</A>, and <A href="/wiki/Texas" title="Texas">Texas</A>, winning every <A href="/wiki/Street_race" class="mw-redirect" title="Street race">street race</A> he participates in, with his red <A href="/wiki/Dodge_Stealth" class="mw-redirect" title="Dodge Stealth">Dodge Stealth</A>. However, he is forced to ditch his car at a motel in <A href="/wiki/San_Antonio" title="San Antonio">San Antonio</A> when police officers are notified of his presence. When they collect the car, he manages to hitch a ride from an unknown woman (<A href="/wiki/Minka_Kelly" title="Minka Kelly">Minka Kelly</A>), despite her knowing who he really is. She drops him at a used car lot, with him realizing she knows that he is a wanted man. There, he buys a green <A href="/wiki/Nissan_Skyline_GT-R#5th_generation_(1999–2002)" title="Nissan Skyline GT-R">Nissan Skyline GT-R R34</A>. Later, collecting money from street races, he modifies the car with new rims and repaints it silver before traveling eastbound and winning more races on the way. Upon reaching <A href="/wiki/Jacksonville,_Florida" title="Jacksonville, Florida">Jacksonville, Florida</A>, Brian heads south toward <A href="/wiki/Miami" title="Miami">Miami</A>, where he sees Slap Jack's <A href="/wiki/Toyota_Supra" title="Toyota Supra">Toyota Supra</A> and Orange Julius' <A href="/wiki/Mazda_RX-7" title="Mazda RX-7">Mazda RX-7</A> (both <I>2 Fast 2 Furious</I> characters) before the screen reads <A href="/wiki/2_Fast_2_Furious" title="2 Fast 2 Furious">"2 be continued..."</A>.
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Los_Bandoleros_.282009.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Los_Bandoleros_(2009)"><I>Los Bandoleros</I> (2009)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=14" title="Edit section: Los Bandoleros (2009)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Los_Bandoleros_(film)" title="Los Bandoleros (film)">Los Bandoleros (film)</A></DIV>
<P>Tego Leo (<A href="/wiki/Tego_Calder%C3%B3n" title="Tego Calderón">Tego Calderón</A>) is in a Dominican Republic prison, ranting about corporations holding back the electric car and starting wars for oil. Meanwhile, on the streets, Rico Santos (<A href="/wiki/Don_Omar" title="Don Omar">Don Omar</A>) chats to an old man unable to find enough gas. Han Lue (<A href="/wiki/Sung_Kang" title="Sung Kang">Sung Kang</A>) arrives and is collected from the airport by Cara (<A href="/wiki/Mirtha_Michelle" title="Mirtha Michelle">Mirtha Michelle</A>) and Malo (F. Valentino Morales). They drive him back to Santos' house, where his aunt Rubia (Adria Carrasco) is struggling with rising prices linked to the cost of gasoline and Dominic is working on his car. The team then enjoy a welcome meal with the family. After breaking Leo out of prison, they head to a club, where Han and Cara flirt, while Dominic meets up with local politician Elvis (<A href="/wiki/Juan_Fern%C3%A1ndez_de_Alarcon" title="Juan Fernández de Alarcon">Juan Fernandez</A>), who informs them of a window of opportunity to hijack a gasoline shipment. While relaxing at the club afterwards, Dominic is surprised by the arrival of Letty, who has tracked him from Mexico. The two drive together to the beach, where they "rekindle their relationship".
</P>

<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Franchise_extension">Franchise extension</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=22" title="Edit section: Franchise extension">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Theme_park_attractions">Theme park attractions</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=23" title="Edit section: Theme park attractions">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Universal has incorporated several theme park attractions involving the Fast & Furious franchise. <A href="/wiki/Universal_Studios_Hollywood" title="Universal Studios Hollywood">Universal Studios Hollywood</A> and its <A href="/wiki/Studio_Tour" title="Studio Tour">Studio Tour</A> has featured several of the picture car vehicles. From 2006 to 2013, <I>The Fast & The Furious: Extreme Close-Up</I> attraction was part of the Studio Tour.<SUP id="cite_ref-49" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-49">[48]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-50" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-50">[49]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-51" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-51">[50]</A></SUP> On June 25, 2015, Universal Studios Hollywood allotted the final portion of their Studio Tour for the dark ride <I><A href="/wiki/Fast_and_Furious:_Supercharged" class="mw-redirect" title="Fast and Furious: Supercharged">Fast and Furious: Supercharged</A></I>.<SUP id="cite_ref-52" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-52">[51]</A></SUP> Universal Orlando announced the development of a ride of the same name to open in 2018.<SUP id="cite_ref-53" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-53">[52]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Fast_.26_Furious_Live"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Fast_&_Furious_Live">Fast & Furious Live</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=24" title="Edit section: Fast & Furious Live">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P><I>Fast & Furious Live</I> is a live show that combines <A href="/wiki/Stunt_driver" class="mw-redirect" title="Stunt driver">stunt drivers</A>, <A href="/wiki/Pyrotechnics" title="Pyrotechnics">pyrotechnics</A> and <A href="/wiki/Projection_mapping" title="Projection mapping">projection mapping</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-54" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-54">[53]</A></SUP> The show had two preview shows on January 11–12 at Liverpool's <A href="/wiki/Echo_Arena" class="mw-redirect" title="Echo Arena">Echo Arena</A>. It officially began its tour at London's <A href="/wiki/The_O2_Arena" title="The O2 Arena">The O2 Arena</A> on January 19, 2018, followed by a worldwide tour until later in 2018. On March 1, 2018, it was revealed on the tour's website that five new dates had been released for September.
</P><P>The following list is sourced from the tour's website.
</P>

<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Video_games">Video games</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=29" title="Edit section: Video games">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The film series has spawned several racing video games for various systems. The arcade game <I>The Fast and the Furious</I> (known as <I>Wild Speed</I> in Japan) was released by <A href="/wiki/Raw_Thrills" title="Raw Thrills">Raw Thrills</A> in 2004.<SUP id="cite_ref-55" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-55">[54]</A></SUP> In 2006, the video game <I><A href="/wiki/The_Fast_and_the_Furious_(2006_video_game)" title="The Fast and the Furious (2006 video game)">The Fast and the Furious</A></I> was released for the <A href="/wiki/PlayStation_2" title="PlayStation 2">PlayStation 2</A> and <A href="/wiki/PlayStation_Portable" title="PlayStation Portable">PlayStation Portable</A>. Several games (<I>The Fast and the Furious: Pink Slip</I>, <I>Fast & Furious</I>, <I>Fast Five</I>, <I>Fast & Furious: Adrenaline</I>, <I>Fast & Furious 6: The Game</I> and <I>Fast & Furious Legacy</I>) have all been released for <A href="/wiki/IOS" title="IOS">iOS</A> and are available on the <A href="/wiki/ITunes" title="ITunes">iTunes</A> <A href="/wiki/App_Store_(iOS)" title="App Store (iOS)">App Store</A>; for <A href="/wiki/Android_(operating_system)" title="Android (operating system)">Android</A> devices there is an official version of <I>Fast & Furious 6: The Game</I> and <I>Fast & Furious Legacy</I>. In 2013, <I><A href="/wiki/Fast_%26_Furious:_Showdown" title="Fast & Furious: Showdown">Fast & Furious: Showdown</A></I> was released for the PC (<A href="/wiki/Microsoft_Windows" title="Microsoft Windows">Windows OS</A>), <A href="/wiki/Xbox_360" title="Xbox 360">Xbox 360</A>, <A href="/wiki/PlayStation_3" title="PlayStation 3">PlayStation 3</A>, <A href="/wiki/Wii_U" title="Wii U">Wii U</A> and <A href="/wiki/Nintendo_3DS" title="Nintendo 3DS">Nintendo 3DS</A>. Various cars, locations and characters from the series have also appeared in the <A href="/wiki/Facebook" title="Facebook">Facebook</A> game <I><A href="/wiki/Car_Town" title="Car Town">Car Town</A></I>. In 2015, in a deal with <A href="/wiki/Microsoft_Studios" title="Microsoft Studios">Microsoft Studios</A>, a standalone expansion of <I><A href="/wiki/Forza_Horizon_2" title="Forza Horizon 2">Forza Horizon 2</A></I> for <A href="/wiki/Xbox_One" title="Xbox One">Xbox One</A> and <A href="/wiki/Xbox_360" title="Xbox 360">Xbox 360</A> was released titled <I><A href="/wiki/Forza_Horizon_2#Development" title="Forza Horizon 2">Forza Horizon 2 Presents Fast & Furious</A></I>.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Toys_and_model_kits">Toys and model kits</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=30" title="Edit section: Toys and model kits">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P><A href="/wiki/Racing_Champions" class="mw-redirect" title="Racing Champions">Racing Champions</A> released <A href="/wiki/Die-cast_toy" title="Die-cast toy">diecast metal</A> replicas of the film's cars in different scales from 1/18 to 1/64.<SUP id="cite_ref-56" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-56">[55]</A></SUP> <A href="/wiki/RadioShack" title="RadioShack">RadioShack</A> sold <A href="/wiki/ZipZaps" title="ZipZaps">ZipZaps</A> micro <A href="/wiki/Radio-controlled_car" title="Radio-controlled car">RC</A> versions of the cars in 2002.<SUP id="cite_ref-57" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-57">[56]</A></SUP> 1/24 scale plastic model kits of the hero cars were manufactured by <A href="/wiki/Ertl_Company" title="Ertl Company">AMT Ertl</A>. Johnny Lightning, under the JL Full Throttle Brand, released 1/64th and 1/24th models of the cars from Tokyo Drift. These models were designed by Diecast Hall of Fame designer Eric Tscherne. Greenlight has also sold cars from the new films in the series and some from the previous films.<SUP id="cite_ref-58" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-58">[57]</A></SUP> <A href="/wiki/Hot_Wheels" title="Hot Wheels">Hot Wheels</A> has released 1/64 models since 2013.<SUP id="cite_ref-59" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-59">[58]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="International_locations">International locations</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=The_Fast_and_the_Furious&action=edit&section=31" title="Edit section: International locations">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P><I>The Fast and the Furious</I> franchise was filmed in a number of countries including: Brazil, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Germany, Iceland, Japan, Mexico, Panama, Puerto Rico, Spain, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, and the United States.<SUP id="cite_ref-60" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-60">[59]</A></SUP>
</P>

<DIV class="mbox-text-span">This Star Wars-related article <B>describes a work or element of fiction in a primarily <A href="/wiki/Wikipedia:Manual_of_Style/Writing_about_fiction" title="Wikipedia:Manual of Style/Writing about fiction">in-universe</A> style</B>. <SPAN class="hide-when-compact">Please <A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit">help rewrite it</A> to <A href="/wiki/Wikipedia:Manual_of_Style/Writing_about_fiction" title="Wikipedia:Manual of Style/Writing about fiction">explain the fiction more clearly and provide non-fictional perspective</A>.</SPAN> <SMALL><I>(February 2008)</I></SMALL> <SMALL class="hide-when-compact"><I>(<A href="/wiki/Help:Maintenance_template_removal" title="Help:Maintenance template removal">Learn how and when to remove this template message</A>)</I></SMALL></DIV>

<P>The <B>Skywalker family</B> is a fictional family in the <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars" title="Star Wars">Star Wars</A></I> franchise. Within the series' <A href="/wiki/Fictional_universe" title="Fictional universe">fictional universe</A>, the Skywalkers are a bloodline with strong inherent capabilities related to <A href="/wiki/Force_(Star_Wars)" class="mw-redirect" title="Force (Star Wars)">the Force</A>. <A href="/wiki/Luke_Skywalker" title="Luke Skywalker">Luke Skywalker</A>, his twin sister <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Princess Leia</A>, and their father <A href="/wiki/Darth_Vader" title="Darth Vader">Darth Vader</A> are central characters in the <A href="/wiki/Star_Wars_original_trilogy" class="mw-redirect" title="Star Wars original trilogy">original <I>Star Wars</I> film trilogy</A>. Vader, in his previous identity as Anakin Skywalker, is a lead character in the <A href="/wiki/Star_Wars_prequel_trilogy" class="mw-redirect" title="Star Wars prequel trilogy">prequel film trilogy</A>. Luke, Leia, and Leia's son <A href="/wiki/Kylo_Ren" title="Kylo Ren">Kylo Ren</A> play crucial roles in the <A href="/wiki/Star_Wars_sequel_trilogy" title="Star Wars sequel trilogy">sequel trilogy</A> of films.</P>

<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="History">History</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: History">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>In terms of the series' internal chronology, the Skywalkers first appeared in the 1999 film <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_I_%E2%80%93_The_Phantom_Menace" title="Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace">Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace</A></I>. In this film, <A href="/wiki/Jedi" title="Jedi">Jedi Knight</A> <A href="/wiki/Qui-Gon_Jinn" title="Qui-Gon Jinn">Qui-Gon Jinn</A> discovers <A href="/wiki/Shmi_Skywalker" class="mw-redirect" title="Shmi Skywalker">Shmi Skywalker</A> and her son Anakin as slaves on the planet <A href="/wiki/Tatooine" title="Tatooine">Tatooine</A>. Qui-Gon finds that Anakin has a higher count of <A href="/wiki/Midi-chlorians" class="mw-redirect" title="Midi-chlorians">midi-chlorians</A> (force-imparting microorganisms) than any Jedi, even <A href="/wiki/Yoda" title="Yoda">Yoda</A>, counting to about 20,000. Shmi informs Qui-Gon that Anakin has no father, leading Qui-Gon to suggest that Anakin is a product of midi-chlorians, an example of a <A href="/wiki/Miraculous_birth" class="mw-redirect" title="Miraculous birth">miraculous birth</A>. As the film progresses, Anakin leaves Tatooine to begin his Jedi training.</P>
<P><I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_II_%E2%80%93_Attack_of_the_Clones" title="Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones">Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones</A></I> reveals that, in Anakin's absence, Shmi has married <A href="/wiki/List_of_Star_Wars_characters#L" title="List of Star Wars characters">Cliegg Lars</A>, becoming the stepmother of <A href="/wiki/List_of_Star_Wars_characters#L" title="List of Star Wars characters">Owen</A>. Owen tells Anakin they are stepbrothers. Owen later marries <A href="/wiki/List_of_Star_Wars_characters#L" title="List of Star Wars characters">Beru Whitesun</A>. As a Jedi Knight, Anakin secretly marries <A href="/wiki/Padm%C3%A9_Amidala" title="Padmé Amidala">Padmé Amidala</A>.</P>
<P>In <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_III_%E2%80%93_Revenge_of_the_Sith" title="Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith">Star Wars: Episode III – Revenge of the Sith</A></I> Padme gives birth to twins, <A href="/wiki/Luke_Skywalker" title="Luke Skywalker">Luke</A> and <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Leia</A>. Luke is raised by Beru and Owen Lars on Tatooine. While Leia is raised by Senator <A href="/wiki/Bail_Organa" title="Bail Organa">Bail Organa</A> and Queen <A href="/wiki/Breha_Organa" class="mw-redirect" title="Breha Organa">Breha Organa</A> on <A href="/wiki/Alderaan_(Star_Wars)" class="mw-redirect" title="Alderaan (Star Wars)">Alderaan</A>.</P>
<P>In <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_The_Force_Awakens" title="Star Wars: The Force Awakens">Star Wars: The Force Awakens</A></I>, Leia and her husband <A href="/wiki/Han_Solo" title="Han Solo">Han Solo</A>, after marrying have a son named <A href="/wiki/Kylo_Ren" title="Kylo Ren">Ben Solo</A>, who later adopts the name Kylo Ren. The family breaks apart following Ben's descent into the dark side, with Leia and Han separating.</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Family_members">Family members</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: Family members">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Shmi_Skywalker-Lars">Shmi Skywalker-Lars</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: Shmi Skywalker-Lars">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Shmi Skywalker is a <A href="/wiki/Fictional_character" class="mw-redirect" title="Fictional character">fictional character</A> in the <I>Star Wars</I> <A href="/wiki/Fictional_universe" title="Fictional universe">universe</A>, portrayed by <A href="/wiki/Pernilla_August" title="Pernilla August">Pernilla August</A>. She appears in <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_I_%E2%80%93_The_Phantom_Menace" title="Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace">Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace</A></I> and <I><A href="/wiki/Star_Wars:_Episode_II_%E2%80%93_Attack_of_the_Clones" title="Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones">Star Wars: Episode II – Attack of the Clones</A></I>. She is the mother of <A href="/wiki/Anakin_Skywalker" class="mw-redirect" title="Anakin Skywalker">Anakin Skywalker</A>, paternal grandmother to <A href="/wiki/Luke_Skywalker" title="Luke Skywalker">Luke Skywalker</A> and <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Leia Organa</A> and paternal-maternal great-grandmother to <A href="/wiki/Kylo_Ren" title="Kylo Ren">Kylo Ren</A>. Her first name is derived from <A href="/wiki/Lakshmi" title="Lakshmi">Lakshmi</A>, a <A href="/wiki/Hindu" title="Hindu">Hindu</A> <A href="/wiki/Goddess" title="Goddess">goddess</A>.</P>
<P>In <I>The Phantom Menace</I>, she and her son are introduced as <A href="/wiki/Slavery" title="Slavery">slaves</A> of junk merchant <A href="/wiki/Watto" title="Watto">Watto</A> on the desert world <A href="/wiki/Tatooine" title="Tatooine">Tatooine</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-1">[1]</A></SUP> She welcomes <A href="/wiki/Jedi" title="Jedi">Jedi Master</A> <A href="/wiki/Qui-Gon_Jinn" title="Qui-Gon Jinn">Qui-Gon Jinn</A> (<A href="/wiki/Liam_Neeson" title="Liam Neeson">Liam Neeson</A>) into their home, and tells him that Anakin has no father; she simply "<A href="/wiki/Parthenogenesis" title="Parthenogenesis">became</A>" <A href="/wiki/Miraculous_birth" class="mw-redirect" title="Miraculous birth">pregnant</A> with him. Qui-Gon helps Anakin win his freedom, but cannot get Shmi out of slavery. She allows Anakin to leave with Qui-Gon, assuring her heartbroken son that they will meet again.</P>
<P>In <I>Attack of the Clones</I>, Anakin (<A href="/wiki/Hayden_Christensen" title="Hayden Christensen">Hayden Christensen</A>), now a young adult <A href="/wiki/Jedi" title="Jedi">Jedi</A> apprentice, senses through the <A href="/wiki/Force_(Star_Wars)" class="mw-redirect" title="Force (Star Wars)">Force</A> that she is in pain. He travels to Tatooine to find her, and, upon arriving, learns that she had been freed by and married to moisture farmer <A href="/wiki/Minor_residents_of_Tatooine#Lars,_Cliegg" class="mw-redirect" title="Minor residents of Tatooine">Cliegg Lars</A> (<A href="/wiki/Jack_Thompson_(actor)" title="Jack Thompson (actor)">Jack Thompson</A>), but had recently been abducted by <A href="/wiki/Tusken_Raiders" title="Tusken Raiders">Tusken Raiders</A>. He finds her inside one of their encampments, but it's too late—beaten and <A href="/wiki/Torture" title="Torture">tortured</A> beyond help, she dies in his arms. Heartbroken and enraged, Anakin slaughters every single Tusken in the camp, including the women and children. His mother's death ignites a strong anger in Anakin, and sets him on the path to becoming <A href="/wiki/Darth_Vader" title="Darth Vader">Darth Vader</A>.</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Anakin_Skywalker_.28Darth_Vader.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Anakin_Skywalker_(Darth_Vader)">Anakin Skywalker (Darth Vader)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Anakin Skywalker (Darth Vader)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Darth_Vader" title="Darth Vader">Darth Vader</A></DIV>
<P>Anakin Skywalker is the son of Shmi Skywalker and no father, due to being conceived through the force. Anakin is discovered on <A href="/wiki/Tatooine" title="Tatooine">Tatooine</A> by Jedi Master <A href="/wiki/Qui-Gon_Jinn" title="Qui-Gon Jinn">Qui-Gon Jinn</A> who is sure that the boy is the "Chosen One" of Jedi Prophecy, who will bring balance to the Force. After the death of Qui-Gon, he becomes the <A href="/wiki/Jedi#Padawan" title="Jedi">Padawan</A> of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He also forms a close bond with <A href="/wiki/Padm%C3%A9_Amidala" title="Padmé Amidala">Padmé Amidala</A>, the young senator of <A href="/wiki/Naboo" title="Naboo">Naboo</A>. The newly elected Chancellor of the Galactic Republic, Palpatine, also befriends Anakin, promising to watch the boy's progress "with great interest" and advise him. Torn between his loyalty to the Jedi and his drive for power, Anakin succumbs to temptation and becomes Darth Vader.</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Padm.C3.A9_Amidala"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Padmé_Amidala">Padmé Amidala</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: Padmé Amidala">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Padm%C3%A9_Amidala" title="Padmé Amidala">Padmé Amidala</A></DIV>
<P>The secret wife of Anakin Skywalker, and mother of Luke and Leia and maternal grandmother of Kylo Ren. She served as Queen of Naboo, and later as a Senator for her planet. Her closest friend in the Senate was Senator Bail Organa. She reconnected and fell in love with Anakin Skywalker after he was assigned to protect her from an assassination attempt, and secretly married him shortly after the Battle of Geonosis, and died while giving birth to her children shortly after the first Empire Day. Obi-Wan and Yoda decided to separate the children in order to keep them hidden from Darth Vader.</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Luke_Skywalker">Luke Skywalker</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: Luke Skywalker">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Luke_Skywalker" title="Luke Skywalker">Luke Skywalker</A></DIV>
<P>Luke Skywalker is the son of Jedi Knight <A href="/wiki/Anakin_Skywalker" class="mw-redirect" title="Anakin Skywalker">Anakin Skywalker</A> and Senator of Naboo, <A href="/wiki/Padm%C3%A9_Amidala" title="Padmé Amidala">Padmé Amidala</A>. He is taken in by his uncle and aunt, Owen and Beru Lars, after the death of Padmé and Anakin's fall to the dark side. He is force sensitive and skilled with a lightsaber. In <I>Return of the Jedi</I>, a dying Yoda confirms to Luke, that Darth Vader (previously Anakin Skywalker) is actually his father, despite Luke's belief that Vader's claim to fatherhood in <I>The Empire Strikes Back</I> was a ruse to pull Luke to the dark side. He also finds out from Obi-Wan's <A href="/wiki/Force_ghost" class="mw-redirect" title="Force ghost">force ghost</A> that Princess Leia Organa is his sister. In <I>The Force Awakens</I>, as the last known Jedi, Luke is in hiding after failing to prevent his nephew Ben (now Kylo Ren) from turning to the dark side to join <A href="/wiki/Supreme_Leader_Snoke" title="Supreme Leader Snoke">Supreme Leader Snoke</A>.</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Leia_Organa">Leia Organa</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: Leia Organa">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Princess Leia</A></DIV>
<P>The daughter of <A href="/wiki/Anakin_Skywalker" class="mw-redirect" title="Anakin Skywalker">Anakin Skywalker</A> and <A href="/wiki/Padm%C3%A9_Amidala" title="Padmé Amidala">Padmé Amidala</A>, <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Leia Organa</A> was adopted by Bail and Breha Organa of Alderaan. At age 19 she is the Princess of Alderaan, and is captured by Darth Vader while in the <A href="/wiki/Tantive_IV" title="Tantive IV">Tantive IV</A> <A href="/wiki/Blockade_runner" title="Blockade runner">blockade runner</A> on a so-called "diplomatic mission". Leia is shown to be force sensitive. In <I><A href="/wiki/The_Empire_Strikes_Back" title="The Empire Strikes Back">The Empire Strikes Back</A></I>, Leia professes her love for <A href="/wiki/Han_Solo" title="Han Solo">Han Solo</A> when he is put into carbonite stasis, although it is originally Han and Luke who compete for her affections. In <I><A href="/wiki/Return_of_the_Jedi" title="Return of the Jedi">Return of the Jedi</A></I>, planning to feed Luke, Han, and <A href="/wiki/Chewbacca" title="Chewbacca">Chewbacca</A> to the flesh eating <A href="/wiki/Sarlacc" title="Sarlacc">Sarlacc</A>, <A href="/wiki/Jabba_the_Hutt" title="Jabba the Hutt">Jabba the Hutt</A> is instead strangled to death by Leia by a chain he has on her. She later becomes involved in the Battle of Endor. In the years that follow, she becomes General Organa, the leader of the Resistance, a military organization unofficially backed by the New Republic to counter the First Order. She married Han Solo and had a son named <A href="/wiki/Ben_Solo" class="mw-redirect" title="Ben Solo">Ben Solo</A>, later Kylo Ren, whose turning to the dark side separated the couple before the events of <I>The Force Awakens</I>. Leia has been on a search to find her missing brother Luke<SUP id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-2">[2]</A></SUP> and save her son from the dark side.</P>
<H3><SPAN id="Ben_Solo_.28Kylo_Ren.29"></SPAN><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Ben_Solo_(Kylo_Ren)">Ben Solo (Kylo Ren)</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Skywalker_family&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: Ben Solo (Kylo Ren)">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Kylo_Ren" title="Kylo Ren">Kylo Ren</A></DIV>
<P>Ben Solo<SUP id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-3">[3]</A></SUP> is the son of <A href="/wiki/Princess_Leia" title="Princess Leia">Leia Organa</A> and <A href="/wiki/Han_Solo" title="Han Solo">Han Solo</A>. He initially trains to be a Jedi under his uncle, <A href="/wiki/Luke_Skywalker" title="Luke Skywalker">Luke Skywalker</A>, before he falls to the dark side and becomes Kylo Ren, working for the First Order and under the influence of <A href="/wiki/Supreme_Leader_Snoke" title="Supreme Leader Snoke">Supreme Leader Snoke</A>. He is obsessed with the legacy of his grandfather, the Sith Lord Darth Vader, and aspires to finish what Vader started: the elimination of the Jedi.</P>
