<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Production">Production</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: Production">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P><I>Bugsy Malone</I> was <A href="/wiki/Alan_Parker" title="Alan Parker">Alan Parker</A>'s first feature film. Parker was trying to find a film project that was not "parochial" and decided upon an American gangster setting: "I had four young children and we used to go to a cottage in Derbyshire at weekends. On the long, boring car journey up there, I started telling them the story of a gangster called Bugsy Malone. They’d ask me questions and I’d make up answers, based on my memories of watching old movie reruns as a kid." His eldest son suggested children should be cast as the "heroes".<SUP id="cite_ref-ParkerBaio_6-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-ParkerBaio-6">[6]</A></SUP></P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Casting">Casting</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Casting">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The director chose to cast several unknown actors in the film. To find his Fat Sam, Parker visited a <A href="/wiki/Brooklyn" title="Brooklyn">Brooklyn</A> classroom, asking for "the naughtiest boy in class". The students were unanimous in selecting <A href="/wiki/John_Cassisi" title="John Cassisi">John Cassisi</A>, and Parker gave him the role. Florrie Dugger (Blousey) was originally cast in a smaller role; when the actress cast as Blousey suddenly grew taller than Baio, Dugger was promoted. She had been "discovered" at <A href="/wiki/RAF_Chicksands" title="RAF Chicksands">RAF Chicksands</A>, an air force base in Bedfordshire where her American father was stationed.<SUP id="cite_ref-Clark_7-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-Clark-7">[7]</A></SUP> At the time of filming, all of the cast were under 17 years old.<SUP id="cite_ref-imdb_trivia_8-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-imdb_trivia-8">[8]</A></SUP></P>
<P>Parker cast Baio after he slammed down the script and stormed out of his audition.<SUP id="cite_ref-ParkerBaio_6-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-ParkerBaio-6">[6]</A></SUP> Baio later remembered:</P>
<BLOCKQUOTE class="templatequote">
<P>I had quit the business, because I didn’t like driving into Manhattan. Well, the long and the short of it is that I wanted to play with my friends after school, but it happened to be raining that day, so I went to the city to meet with Alan Parker. I read it, but I just barely read it. I didn’t even want to be there. He was English, but I didn’t even know what that was. He was just this weird guy with long hair, and I didn’t know what he was. [Laughs.] So I sort of read the script, threw it at him, and walked out the door. That was it: I’d gotten the part before I got home.<SUP id="cite_ref-av_9-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-av-9">[9]</A></SUP></P>
</BLOCKQUOTE>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Music">Music</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: Music">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Parker chose <A href="/wiki/Paul_Williams_(songwriter)" title="Paul Williams (songwriter)">Paul Williams</A> to score the film in order to get a more "palatable" modern sound, and simply because he liked him.<SUP id="cite_ref-10" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-10">[10]</A></SUP> Williams had scored <A href="/wiki/Brian_De_Palma" title="Brian De Palma">Brian De Palma</A>'s commercial failure <I><A href="/wiki/Phantom_of_the_Paradise" title="Phantom of the Paradise">Phantom of the Paradise</A></I>, but had also written huge pop-radio hits (such as "<A href="/wiki/We%27ve_Only_Just_Begun" title="We've Only Just Begun">We've Only Just Begun</A>" (lyrics), and "<A href="/wiki/An_Old_Fashioned_Love_Song" title="An Old Fashioned Love Song">(Just An) Old Fashioned Love Song</A>"). In fact, Williams would soon win an <A href="/wiki/Academy_Award" class="mw-redirect" title="Academy Award">Oscar</A> for his song "<A href="/wiki/Evergreen_(Love_Theme_from_A_Star_Is_Born)" title="Evergreen (Love Theme from A Star Is Born)">Evergreen</A>" from the film <I><A href="/wiki/A_Star_Is_Born_(1976_film)" title="A Star Is Born (1976 film)">A Star Is Born</A></I> (1976).</P>
<P>Williams felt that "...the challenge for me was to provide songs that reflected the period ... and yet maintained an energy that would hold the young audiences attention." According to Parker, Williams was writing while on tour, recording songs in different cities, and sending the completed tapes to Hollywood. Arriving during the first pre-shoot rehearsals, the songs had to be accepted and used as they were, with voices by Williams, Archie Hahn and others.</P>
<P>Neither the director nor the songwriter was entirely comfortable with the results. Williams later wrote "I'm really proud of the work and the only thing I've ever doubted is the choice of using adult voices. Perhaps I should have given the kids a chance to sing the songs." Parker also commented: "Watching the film after all these years, this is one aspect that I find the most bizarre. Adult voices coming out of these kids' mouths? I had told Paul that I didn't want squeaky kids voices and he interpreted this in his own way. Anyway, as the tapes arrived, scarcely weeks away from filming, we had no choice but to go along with it!"<SUP id="cite_ref-PW_11-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-PW-11">[11]</A></SUP></P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Filming">Filming</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: Filming">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The film was rehearsed and shot in England, largely on <A href="/wiki/Pinewood_Studios" title="Pinewood Studios">Pinewood Studios</A>' "H" stage, with locations in <A href="/wiki/Black_Park" title="Black Park">Black Park Country Park</A> (Wexham, Buckinghamshire) and Reading, Berkshire.</P>
<P>The "splurge firearm" proved to be problematic. After initial experiments with cream-filled wax balls proved painful, Parker decided to abandon the idea of filming the firearms directly. Instead, the firearms fired ping-pong balls, and a <A href="/wiki/Fast_cutting" title="Fast cutting">fast cut</A> to a victim being pelted with "splurge" was used to convey the impression of the rapid-firing firearms.<SUP id="cite_ref-imdb_trivia_8-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-imdb_trivia-8">[8]</A></SUP></P>
<P>Baio later said making the film was "awesome":</P>
<BLOCKQUOTE class="templatequote">
<P>A kid’s fantasy: You get to dress up as gangster, you get to shoot guns that fire whipped cream, you get to drive cars with pedals that look like real cars, and you get to talk like a grown-up. I mean, you couldn’t ask for a better first big gig. Talk about getting you hooked on a business! It was fantastic.<SUP id="cite_ref-av_9-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-av-9">[9]</A></SUP></P>
</BLOCKQUOTE>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Release">Release</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: Release">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P><I>Bugsy Malone</I> was released in late 1976 to generally positive reviews. On <A href="/wiki/Rotten_Tomatoes" title="Rotten Tomatoes">Rotten Tomatoes</A>, it currently holds a score of 83% based on 18 reviews, with an average rating of 6.6/10.<SUP id="cite_ref-12" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-12">[12]</A></SUP> Despite the positive critical reception, <I>Bugsy Malone</I> was not a commercial success in the US, bringing in just over $2.7 million. Paramount gave it a <A href="/wiki/Limited_release" title="Limited release">limited release</A>, usually in second-tier theaters in a double-bill with <I><A href="/wiki/The_Bad_News_Bears" title="The Bad News Bears">The Bad News Bears</A></I>, which had already been out for six months and was no longer much of a draw. According to Parker, the film was "quite successful" in the United Kingdom. By 1985, it had earned an estimated profit of £1,854,000.<SUP id="cite_ref-walker_3-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-walker-3">[3]</A></SUP></P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Accolades">Accolades</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: Accolades">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>The film garnered 15 award nominations, including "Best Motion Picture (Musical/Comedy)", "Best Original Score" and "Best Original Song" (for the title track) from the <A href="/wiki/Golden_Globe" class="mw-redirect" title="Golden Globe">Golden Globes</A>, and an <A href="/wiki/Academy_Awards" title="Academy Awards">Oscar</A> for "<A href="/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Original_Score" title="Academy Award for Best Original Score">Best Original Song Score</A>" (Paul Williams). The film was in competition for the <A href="/wiki/Palme_d%27Or" title="Palme d'Or">Palme d'Or</A> at the <A href="/wiki/1976_Cannes_Film_Festival" title="1976 Cannes Film Festival">1976 Cannes Film Festival</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-festival-cannes.com_13-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-festival-cannes.com-13">[13]</A></SUP> Actress Jodie Foster received two <A href="/wiki/BAFTA" class="mw-redirect" title="BAFTA">BAFTAs</A>, "Best Supporting Actress" and "Most Promising Newcomer to Leading Film Roles", however, both her nominations were for her previous year's work in <I>Taxi Driver</I> in addition to her work on <I>Bugsy Malone</I>. <A href="/wiki/Alan_Parker" title="Alan Parker">Alan Parker</A> received the <A href="/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Original_Screenplay" title="BAFTA Award for Best Original Screenplay">BAFTA Award for Best Original Screenplay</A>, and a nomination for <A href="/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Direction" title="BAFTA Award for Best Direction">Best Direction</A>. <A href="/wiki/Geoffrey_Kirkland" title="Geoffrey Kirkland">Geoffrey Kirkland</A> won the <A href="/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Production_Design" title="BAFTA Award for Best Production Design">BAFTA Award for Best Production Design</A>. Additionally, <A href="/wiki/Paul_Williams_(songwriter)" title="Paul Williams (songwriter)">Paul Williams</A> received a nomination for the <A href="/wiki/BAFTA_Award_for_Best_Film_Music" title="BAFTA Award for Best Film Music">Anthony Asquith Award for Film Music</A>, and <A href="/wiki/Monica_Howe" title="Monica Howe">Monica Howe</A> a Best Costume Design nomination. The film itself received a Best Picture nomination.<SUP id="cite_ref-14" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-14">[14]</A></SUP></P>
<P>In 2008, the <A href="/wiki/American_Film_Institute" title="American Film Institute">American Film Institute</A> nominated this film for its <A href="/wiki/AFI%27s_10_Top_10" title="AFI's 10 Top 10">Top 10 Gangster Films list</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-15" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-15">[15]</A></SUP></P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Home_media">Home media</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section: Home media">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>In the early eighties, <I>Bugsy Malone</I> was released on VHS. On 16 April 1996, it was re-released by Paramount on VHS. Although the film has never been commercially released on Region 1 DVD, it has been available through Internet sites as an Asian import supporting Region 1 (US). On 9 September 2008, Arista/SME released a <A href="/wiki/Blu-ray_Disc" class="mw-redirect" title="Blu-ray Disc">Blu-ray</A> version, encoded for "all regions", as a United Kingdom import. This edition includes a <A href="/wiki/Audio_commentary" title="Audio commentary">director's commentary</A> as well as other special features, however, as of October 2009, the Blu-ray version was discontinued. A US DVD (Region 1) release was listed around 2003/04 as being available soon, however the film has yet to be released in this format.</P>
<DIV style="clear:both;"></DIV>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Soundtrack">Soundtrack</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section: Soundtrack">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<DIV class="thumb tright">
<DIV class="thumbinner" style="width:252px;"><A href="/wiki/File:Bugsy_Malone-CD_soundtrack.jpg" class="image"><IMG alt="" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/thumb/d/d1/Bugsy_Malone-CD_soundtrack.jpg/250px-Bugsy_Malone-CD_soundtrack.jpg" width="250" height="250" class="thumbimage" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/d/d1/Bugsy_Malone-CD_soundtrack.jpg 1.5x" data-file-width="316" data-file-height="316" /></A>
<DIV class="thumbcaption">
<DIV class="magnify"><A href="/wiki/File:Bugsy_Malone-CD_soundtrack.jpg" class="internal" title="Enlarge"></A></DIV>
CD cover</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<P>The album was originally released as an <A href="/wiki/LP_album" class="mw-redirect" title="LP album">LP</A> in 1976. In March 1996, <A href="/wiki/Polydor_Records#Polydor_UK" title="Polydor Records">Polydor UK</A> released the soundtrack on CD. It has yet to be released in the US on CD but is available through various outlets as an import.</P>
<P>Performers include <A href="/wiki/Paul_Williams_(songwriter)" title="Paul Williams (songwriter)">Paul Williams</A>, <A href="/wiki/Archie_Hahn_(actor)" title="Archie Hahn (actor)">Archie Hahn</A>, <A href="/wiki/Julie_McWhirter" title="Julie McWhirter">Julie McWhirter</A>, and <A href="/wiki/Liberty_Williams" class="mw-redirect" title="Liberty Williams">Liberty Williams</A>. The track listing is:</P>
<OL>
<LI>"Bugsy Malone" – Paul Williams</LI>
<LI>"Fat Sam's Grand Slam" – Paul Williams</LI>
<LI>"Tomorrow"</LI>
<LI>"Bad Guys"</LI>
<LI>"I'm Feeling Fine"</LI>
<LI>"My Name Is Tallulah" - Louise "Liberty" Williams</LI>
<LI>"So You Wanna Be a Boxer?"</LI>
<LI>"Ordinary Fool"</LI>
<LI>"Down and Out"</LI>
<LI>"You Give a Little Love" – Paul Williams</LI>
</OL>
<P>A cast recording of the <A href="/wiki/National_Youth_Music_Theatre" title="National Youth Music Theatre">National Youth Music Theatre</A> stage version of <I>Bugsy Malone</I> was released in 1998. Like the stage show, this recording featured two songs originally written by Williams, but not used in the film: "That's Why They Call Him Dandy" and "Show Business". There is also some additional incidental orchestral score, such as an <I>Overture</I> and <I>Exit Music</I>, with music arranged by John Pearson.</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Legacy">Legacy</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section: Legacy">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>In 2003, <I>Bugsy Malone</I> was voted #19 on a list of the 100 greatest musicals, as chosen by viewers of Channel 4 in the UK, placing it higher than <I><A href="/wiki/The_Phantom_of_the_Opera_(1986_musical)" title="The Phantom of the Opera (1986 musical)">The Phantom of the Opera</A></I>, <I><A href="/wiki/Cats_(musical)" title="Cats (musical)">Cats</A></I>, and <I><A href="/wiki/The_King_and_I" title="The King and I">The King and I</A></I>.<SUP id="cite_ref-16" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-16">[16]</A></SUP> <I>Bugsy Malone</I> ranks 353rd on <I><A href="/wiki/Empire_Magazine" class="mw-redirect" title="Empire Magazine">Empire Magazine</A></I>'s 2008 list of the 500 greatest movies of all time.<SUP id="cite_ref-17" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-17">[17]</A></SUP></P>
<P><I>Bugsy Malone</I> has been adapted into a stage show in two forms.<SUP id="cite_ref-mti_18-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-mti-18">[18]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-mtiJr_19-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-mtiJr-19">[19]</A></SUP> A 2003 television documentary called <I>Bugsy Malone: After They Were Famous</I> features a reunion and interviews with Jodie Foster, Scott Baio, John Cassisi and Florrie Dugger. The British actors who played Fat Sam's gang are also reunited at <A href="/wiki/Pinewood_Studios" title="Pinewood Studios">Pinewood Studios</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-20" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-20">[20]</A></SUP> The documentary reported that Dugger, who (unlike her co-stars) had never acted again, had chosen to pursue a career in the <A href="/wiki/United_States_Air_Force_Medical_Service" title="United States Air Force Medical Service">United States Air Force Medical Service</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-21" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-21">[21]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-Clark_7-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-Clark-7">[7]</A></SUP></P>
<P>In 2010, UK band <A href="/wiki/Silvery" title="Silvery">Silvery</A> included a cover of "You Give a Little Love" on their second album 'Railway Architecture', and <A href="/wiki/Olly_Murs" title="Olly Murs">Olly Murs</A>, runner up in the 2009 UK series of <I><A href="/wiki/The_X_Factor_(UK)" class="mw-redirect" title="The X Factor (UK)">The X Factor</A></I>, sampled "So You Wanna Be a Boxer" in his song "Hold On" that can be found on his <A href="/wiki/Olly_Murs_(album)" title="Olly Murs (album)">debut album</A>.</P>
<P>In 2011, the film was the most screened film in <A href="/wiki/Secondary_school" title="Secondary school">secondary schools</A> in the United Kingdom.<SUP id="cite_ref-BBC_News_22-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-BBC_News-22">[22]</A></SUP></P>
<P>In 2017, the song "You Give A Little Love" was sung by a children's chorus at the end of a Netflix "Black Mirror" episode (Season 4 episode 3 "Crocodile").</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Stage_adaptation">Stage adaptation</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Bugsy_Malone&action=edit&section=12" title="Edit section: Stage adaptation">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>Parker wrote the book for a stage adaptation of <I>Bugsy Malone</I>, using Williams' music. This premiered in the <A href="/wiki/West_End_theatre" title="West End theatre">West End</A> in 1983 at <A href="/wiki/Her_Majesty%27s_Theatre" title="Her Majesty's Theatre">Her Majesty's Theatre</A> and ran for 300 performances. It was directed by <A href="/wiki/Michael_Dolenz" class="mw-redirect" title="Michael Dolenz">Michael Dolenz</A> and the cast featured <A href="/wiki/Catherine_Zeta-Jones" title="Catherine Zeta-Jones">Catherine Zeta-Jones</A> as Tallulah. In 1997, the <A href="/wiki/National_Youth_Music_Theatre" title="National Youth Music Theatre">National Youth Music Theatre</A> mounted an all-youth version. It was revived at the <A href="/wiki/Queen%27s_Theatre" title="Queen's Theatre">Queen's Theatre</A> in 1997, starring <A href="/wiki/Sheridan_Smith" title="Sheridan Smith">Sheridan Smith</A> and <A href="/wiki/Jamie_Bell" title="Jamie Bell">Jamie Bell</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-23" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-23">[23]</A></SUP> Another revival played in 2015 and again in 2016 at the <A href="/wiki/Lyric_Hammersmith" class="mw-redirect" title="Lyric Hammersmith">Lyric Hammersmith</A> theatre,<SUP id="cite_ref-24" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-24">[24]</A></SUP> where it was nominated for the <A href="/wiki/Olivier_Award" class="mw-redirect" title="Olivier Award">Olivier Award</A> for best musical revival.<SUP id="cite_ref-25" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-25">[25]</A></SUP></P>

<P>A <B>property tax</B> or <B>millage rate</B><SUP id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-1">[1]</A></SUP> is an <A href="/wiki/Ad_valorem_tax" title="Ad valorem tax">ad valorem tax</A> on the value of a property, usually levied on <A href="/wiki/Real_estate" title="Real estate">real estate</A>. The tax is levied by the governing authority of the jurisdiction in which the property is located. This can be a national government, a <A href="/wiki/Federated_state" title="Federated state">federated state</A>, a county or geographical region or a <A href="/wiki/Local_government" title="Local government">municipality</A>. Multiple jurisdictions may tax the same <A href="/wiki/Property" title="Property">property</A>. This tax can be contrasted to a rent tax which is based on rental income or <A href="/wiki/Imputed_rent" title="Imputed rent">imputed rent</A>, and a <A href="/wiki/Land_value_tax" title="Land value tax">land value tax</A>, which is a levy on the value of land, excluding the value of buildings and other improvements.
</P><P>Under a property-tax system, the government requires or performs an <A href="/wiki/Real_estate_appraisal" title="Real estate appraisal">appraisal</A> of the monetary value of each property, and tax is assessed in proportion to that value.
</P>

<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Types">Types</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: Types">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>The four broad types of property taxes are land, improvements to land (immovable man-made objects, such as buildings), personal property (movable man-made objects) and <A href="/wiki/Intangible_property" title="Intangible property">intangible property</A>. <A href="/wiki/Real_property" title="Real property">Real property</A> (also called real estate or realty) is the combination of land and improvements.
</P><P>Forms of property tax vary across jurisdictions. Real property is often taxed based on its class. Classification is the grouping of properties based on similar use. Properties in different classes are taxed at different rates. Examples of property classes are residential, commercial, industrial and vacant real property.<SUP id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-2">[2]</A></SUP> In <A href="/wiki/Israel" title="Israel">Israel</A>, for example, property tax rates are double for vacant apartments versus occupied apartments.<SUP id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-3">[3]</A></SUP>
</P><P>A <A href="/wiki/Special_assessment_tax" title="Special assessment tax">special assessment tax</A> is sometimes confused with property tax. These are two distinct forms of taxation: one (<I><A href="/wiki/Ad_valorem_tax" title="Ad valorem tax">ad valorem tax</A></I>) relies upon the <A href="/wiki/Fair_market_value" title="Fair market value">fair market value</A> of the property. The other (special assessment) relies upon a special enhancement called a "benefit" for its justification.
</P><P>The <I>property tax rate</I> is typically given as a <A href="/wiki/Percentage" title="Percentage">percentage</A>. It may be expressed as a <A href="/wiki/Per_mil" class="mw-redirect" title="Per mil">per mil</A> (amount of tax per thousand currency units of property value), which is also known as a <I>millage rate</I> or <I>mill</I> (one-thousandth of a currency unit). To calculate the property tax, the authority multiplies the assessed value by the mill rate and then divides by 1,000. For example, a property with an assessed value of $50,000 located in a municipality with a mill rate of 20 mills would have a property tax bill of $1,000 per year.<SUP id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-4">[4]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Jurisdictions">Jurisdictions</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: Jurisdictions">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>Property classes, tax rates, assessment rules and valuations vary by jurisdiction.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Australia">Australia</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: Australia">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Australian property is taxed at both the state and council (local municipal) level.   Taxes are payable by property owners - there is no property tax charged to renters.
</P><P>A state tax commonly called "stamp duty" is assessed when is property is purchased or transferred.  It is typically around 5% of the purchase price, payable by the purchaser.   Other transfer charges may also apply, including special fees for investors from overseas.<SUP id="cite_ref-5" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-5">[5]</A></SUP>
</P><P>"Land tax" - also a state tax - is assessed every year on a property's value.  Most Australians do not pay land tax, as most states provide a land tax exemption for the primary home or residence.  Depending on the state, surcharge tax rates can apply to foreign owners.<SUP id="cite_ref-6" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-6">[6]</A></SUP>
</P><P>"Council rates" is a municipal tax levied by local government.  This is assessed each year on a property's value.  Council rates are around $1300 per annum for an average Australian household.<SUP id="cite_ref-7" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-7">[7]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Brazil">Brazil</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Brazil">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Brazil is a Federation Republic, and its federated entities (internal States and Municipalities), as well as the Federal government, levy property taxes. They are all declared in the Federal Constitution.
</P><P>These are the current property taxes:
</P>
<UL><LI>Tax on Rural Territorial Property – federal: levied upon real state property on rural areas;</LI>
<LI>Tax on Urban Territorial Property – municipal: levied upon real state property on urban areas;</LI>
<LI>Tax on Motorized Vehicles Property – state: levied upon the property of cars, trucks, motorcycles, and the likes;</LI>
<LI>Tax on Big Fortunes – federal: it is declared on the Federal Constitution, but there is still no regulation defining its incidence.</LI></UL>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Canada">Canada</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: Canada">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Many provinces levy property tax on real estate based upon land use and value. This is the major source of revenue for most <A href="/wiki/Municipal_government_in_Canada" title="Municipal government in Canada">municipal governments</A>. While property tax levels vary across municipalities, a common property assessment or valuation criteria is laid out in provincial legislation. The trend is to use a market value standard for valuation purposes with varying revaluation cycles. Multiple provinces established an annual reassessment cycle where market activity warrants, while others have longer periods between valuation periods.
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Calculating_Individual_Property_Taxes">Calculating Individual Property Taxes</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: Calculating Individual Property Taxes">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>In Ontario, for most properties (e.g., residential, farms), property taxes can be calculated by multiplying the phased-in assessment indicated on the Property Assessment Notice by the tax rate.
</P><P>The municipal tax rate x phased-in assessment for the particular taxation year = municipal portion of tax.
</P><P>The county/regional tax rate x phased-in assessment for the particular taxation year = county/regional portion of tax.
</P><P>The education tax rate x phased-in assessment for the particular taxation year = education portion of tax.
</P><P>The municipal portion of tax + county/regional portion of tax + education portion of tax = Total Property Tax.
</P><P>In some cases (e.g., commercial, industrial, multi-residential properties), the Province or municipality may implement measures that affect the actual taxes paid on a property.
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Land_Transfer_Tax">Land Transfer Tax</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: Land Transfer Tax">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>Land transfer tax is a provincial tax levied when purchasing a home or land in Canada. All provinces have a land transfer tax, except <A href="/wiki/Alberta" title="Alberta">Alberta</A> and <A href="/wiki/Saskatchewan" title="Saskatchewan">Saskatchewan</A>. In most provinces the tax is calculated as a percentage of the purchase price.  In <A href="/wiki/Toronto" title="Toronto">Toronto</A> there is an additional municipal tax.
</P><P><A href="/wiki/Ontario" title="Ontario">Ontario</A>, <A href="/wiki/British_Columbia" title="British Columbia">British Columbia</A>, <A href="/wiki/Prince_Edward_Island" title="Prince Edward Island">Prince Edward Island</A> and the City of Toronto offer land transfer tax rebates for first-time homebuyers.
<SUP id="cite_ref-8" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-8">[8]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-9" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-9">[9]</A></SUP>
</P><P><SPAN id="Property_Transfer_Tax_Act"></SPAN>
</P>
<H5><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="British_Columbia">British Columbia</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: British Columbia">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H5>
<P>In British Columbia  the property transfer tax is equal to one percent tax on the first $200,000 of the purchase price, two percent on the remaining amount up to $2 million and three percent on the rest.<SUP id="cite_ref-10" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-10">[10]</A></SUP> An additional <A href="/wiki/15-per-cent_tax" class="mw-redirect" title="15-per-cent tax">15% tax</A> that applies only to non-resident foreign <A href="/wiki/Home_buyer" class="mw-redirect" title="Home buyer">home buyers</A> in <A href="/wiki/Greater_Vancouver" title="Greater Vancouver">Greater Vancouver</A> started on August 2, 2016. The definition of foreign buyer includes <A href="/wiki/International_student" title="International student">international students</A> and <A href="/wiki/Temporary_foreign_worker" class="mw-redirect" title="Temporary foreign worker">temporary foreign workers</A>. <A href="/wiki/Anti-avoidance" class="mw-redirect" title="Anti-avoidance">Anti-avoidance</A> measures include <A href="/wiki/Fine_(penalty)" title="Fine (penalty)">fines</A> of $100,000 for <A href="/wiki/Individual" title="Individual">individuals</A> and $200,000 for <A href="/wiki/Corporation" title="Corporation">corporations</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-11" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-11">[11]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H6><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="First_time_home_buyers_program">First time home buyers program</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section: First time home buyers program">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H6>
<P>The First Time Home Buyers Program is a program by the <A href="/wiki/BC_government" class="mw-redirect" title="BC government">BC government</A> that offers qualifying first-time <A href="/wiki/Homebuyer" class="mw-redirect" title="Homebuyer">homebuyers</A> a reduction or elimination of the property transfer tax. It can be used in conjunction with the <A href="/wiki/B.C._Home_Owner_Mortgage_and_Equity_Partnership" class="mw-redirect" title="B.C. Home Owner Mortgage and Equity Partnership">B.C. Home Owner Mortgage and Equity Partnership</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-12" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-12">[12]</A></SUP>
</P><P>The First Time Home Buyers Tax Credit is also available in Ontario, which offers First Time Home Buyers a 750 dollar tax Rebate. In 2017 the Ontario Government also released the Land Transfer Tax Rebate, which allowed for up to 4,000 dollar rebate - ensuring that first time home buyers of homes valued under 368,000 dollars would not pay land transfer tax.<SUP id="cite_ref-13" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-13">[13]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H6><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="New_home_exemption">New home exemption</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section: New home exemption">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H6>
<P>The Newly Built Home Exemption is a program that reduces or eliminates the property transfer tax on new homes. The amount is limited to $13,000 for qualifying individuals who must be either a Canadian citizen or a permanent resident. The property purchased must be located in British Columbia, have a fair market value of $750,000, be smaller than 1.25 acres and be used as a principle residence. It can be used in conjunction with the <A href="/wiki/B.C._Home_Owner_Mortgage_and_Equity_Partnership" class="mw-redirect" title="B.C. Home Owner Mortgage and Equity Partnership">B.C. Home Owner Mortgage and Equity Partnership</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-14" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-14">[14]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Chile">Chile</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section: Chile">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The land property tax, called "territorial tax" or "contribution", is an annual amount paid quarterly by the property's owner. It is determined as a percentage of the property's "fiscal value", which is calculated by the Internal Revenue Service, based on the property's land and built area, construction materials, age and use. The fiscal value, which is usually much lower than the market value, may be disputed by the owner. The annual levy varies between 1 and 2% of this value, depending on the property's use (residential, agricultural or commercial). Residential properties valued below US$40K (as of 2013) are not taxed; those above that threshold are taxed only on the amount exceeding US$40K.<SUP id="cite_ref-15" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-15">[15]</A></SUP> Revenues go to the <A href="/wiki/Communes_of_Chile" title="Communes of Chile">municipality</A> administering the property's <A href="/wiki/Communes_of_Chile" title="Communes of Chile">commune</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-16" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-16">[16]</A></SUP> All municipalities contribute a share of the revenue to a "common municipal fund" that is then redistributed back to municipalities according to a their needs (commune's poverty rate, etc.).<SUP id="cite_ref-17" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-17">[17]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-18" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-18">[18]</A></SUP> Additionally, municipalities charge a quarterly trash collection tax, which is often paid together with the territorial tax (if applicable).
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Egypt">Egypt</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=12" title="Edit section: Egypt">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The law imposes a tax on each property. Public buildings are excluded (such as government buildings), as are religious buildings (mosques and churches). Families owning private properties worth up to LE 2 million ($290,000) are exempt. commercial stores with an annual rent value over LE 1,200 are not exempt.<SUP id="cite_ref-19" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-19">[19]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Greece">Greece</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=13" title="Edit section: Greece">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Greece has a Municipal and a Government property tax. The municipal property tax (ΤΑΠ/ΔΤ/ΔΦ) is included in electricity bills and incorporates, among others, charges for street cleaning and lighting. The Government property tax (ENFIA) is a combination of the individual asset's tax based upon floor-area and a progressive real-estate wealth tax per individual which is based on the estimated net-worth of all properties and can reach 2%.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Hong_Kong">Hong Kong</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=14" title="Edit section: Hong Kong">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>In Hong Kong, the "property tax" is not an<I> <A href="/wiki/Ad_valorem_tax" title="Ad valorem tax">ad valorem tax</A></I>; it is actually an <A href="/wiki/Income_tax" title="Income tax">income tax</A>.
</P><P>According to <A href="/wiki/Inland_Revenue_Ordinance_Cap.112" class="mw-redirect" title="Inland Revenue Ordinance Cap.112">HK Inland Revenue Ordinance</A> IRO s5B, all property owners are not be subject to this tax unless they received a <A href="/wiki/Consideration" title="Consideration">consideration</A>, like rental income for the <A href="#Year_of_assessment">year of assessment</A>. The property tax is computed on the <A href="#Net_assessable_value">net assessable value</A> at the standard rate. The period of assessment is from 1 April to 31 March.
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Net_assessable_value">Net assessable value</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=15" title="Edit section: Net assessable value">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>The formula is:
</P>
<DL><DD>Net assessable value = 80% of Assessable value.</DD></DL>
<DL><DD>HK property tax payable = Net assessment value X Property tax standard rate</DD></DL>
<DL><DD>Assessable value = Rental income + Premium + (Rental bad debt recovered — Irrecoverable rent) – <A href="/wiki/Rates_(tax)#Hong_Kong" title="Rates (tax)">Rates</A> paid by owner.</DD></DL>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="India">India</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=16" title="Edit section: India">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Property tax or 'house tax' is a local tax on buildings, along with appurtenant land. It is and imposed on the Possessor (not the custodian of property as per 1978, 44th amendment of constitution). It resembles the US-type wealth tax and differs from the excise-type UK rate. The tax power is vested in the states and is delegated to local bodies, specifying the valuation method, rate band, and collection procedures. The tax base is the annual rental value (ARV) or area-based rating. Owner-occupied and other properties not producing rent are assessed on cost and then converted into ARV by applying a percentage of cost, usually four percent. Vacant land is generally exempt. Central government properties are exempt. Instead a 'service charge' is permissible under executive order. Properties of foreign missions also enjoy tax exemption without requiring reciprocity. The tax is usually accompanied by service taxes, e.g., water tax, drainage tax, conservancy (sanitation) tax, lighting tax, all using the same tax base. The rate structure is flat on rural (panchayat) properties, but in the urban (municipal) areas it is mildly progressive with about 80% of assessments falling in the first two brackets.<SUP id="cite_ref-20" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-20">[20]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Ireland">Ireland</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=17" title="Edit section: Ireland">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Local_Property_Tax_(Ireland)" class="mw-redirect" title="Local Property Tax (Ireland)">Local Property Tax (Ireland)</A></DIV>
<P>A Local Property Tax came into effect in <A href="/wiki/Republic_of_Ireland" title="Republic of Ireland">Republic of Ireland</A> on 1 July 2013, and is collected by the <A href="/wiki/Revenue_Commissioners" title="Revenue Commissioners">Revenue Commissioners</A>. The tax is on residential properties. The property owner is liable (though in the case of leases over twenty years, the tenant is liable). The revenue funds the provision of services by <A href="/wiki/Local_government_in_the_Republic_of_Ireland" title="Local government in the Republic of Ireland">local authorities</A>. Such services currently include public parks, libraries, open spaces and leisure amenities, planning and development, fire and emergency services, maintenance and street cleaning and lighting.
</P><P>The tax is based upon market value, taxed via a system of market bands. The initial national central rate of the tax is 0.18% of a property's value up to €1 million. Properties valued over €1 million are assessed 0.25% on the excess. From 1 January 2015, local authorities are able to vary LPT rates -/+ 15% of the national central rate.
</P><P>In the case of properties valued over €1 million, no banding applies – 0.18% is charged on the first €1 million (€1,800) and 0.25% on the balance. The government estimates that 85% to 90% of all properties fall within the first five taxation bands.<SUP id="cite_ref-21" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-21">[21]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-22" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-22">[22]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Jamaica">Jamaica</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=18" title="Edit section: Jamaica">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>This tax is paid annually and is based on a percentage of the unimproved value of a property.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Lithuania">Lithuania</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=19" title="Edit section: Lithuania">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The tax period for a property tax is a calendar year. Property tax rate ranging from 0.3% to 1% the tax value of real estate is determined by the municipality.
</P><P>Since January 1<SUP>st</SUP> 2015 if the persons property value is higher than 220 000 euros, 0.5 per cent of property tax is applied for exceeding amount. 
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Luxembourg">Luxembourg</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=20" title="Edit section: Luxembourg">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Property tax in <A href="/wiki/Luxembourg" title="Luxembourg">Luxembourg</A> is calculated on the basis of the property's "unitary value" determined by tax authorities and levied by the communes. The tax is calculated as property unitary value * assessment rate * communal rate. The assessment rate is determined by the legislator and generally ranges from 0.7% to 1%. The communal rate is set by the communal authority and varies from 120% to 900% depending on the municipality.
</P><P>Luxembourg has minimal property taxes compared to its neighbours in <A href="/wiki/Benelux" title="Benelux">Benelux</A> or in the <A href="/wiki/European_Union" title="European Union">European Union</A>. It amounts to more or less €150 for a €500 000 apartment in Luxembourg City.<SUP id="cite_ref-23" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-23">[23]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-24" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-24">[24]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Netherlands">Netherlands</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=21" title="Edit section: Netherlands">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Property tax (<A href="/wiki/Dutch_language" title="Dutch language">Dutch</A>: <I>Onroerendezaakbelasting (OZB)</I>) is levied on property on a municipal basis. Only the owners of residential property and people who rent/own commercial space are taxed. People who rent a home do not pay property tax. Municipalities combine their property taxes with a tax for garbage collection and for the sewer system. Owners and users of property and land also pay taxes based on the value of property to the water boards for flood protection and water and wastewater treatment ("waterschapsbelasting"). A  percentage of the value of a house ("<I>huurwaardeforfait</I>") is added to the income of the owner, so the owner of a house pays more income tax. All property-related taxes are based on the value of the house estimated by the municipality.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="United_Kingdom">United Kingdom</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=22" title="Edit section: United Kingdom">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">See also: <A href="/wiki/Business_rates_in_England_and_Wales" class="mw-redirect" title="Business rates in England and Wales">Business rates in England and Wales</A></DIV>
<P>In the UK the <I>ownership</I> of residential property or land is not taxed, a situation almost unique in the <A href="/wiki/Organisation_for_Economic_Co-operation_and_Development" class="mw-redirect" title="Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development">OECD</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-25" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-25">[25]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-26" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-26">[26]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-27" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-27">[27]</A></SUP> Instead, the <A href="/wiki/Council_Tax" title="Council Tax">Council Tax</A> is usually paid by the <I>resident</I> of a property, and only in the case of unoccupied property does the owner become liable to pay it (although owners can often obtain a discount or an exemption for empty properties).<SUP id="cite_ref-28" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-28">[28]</A></SUP>
</P><P>Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs (<A href="/wiki/HM_Revenue_and_Customs" title="HM Revenue and Customs">HMRC</A>) guidelines state:
</P>
<DL><DD>"Council Tax is a tax on property. In principle it may be an allowable deduction in those instances where other property-based expenses are deductible."<SUP id="cite_ref-29" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-29">[29]</A></SUP></DD></DL>
<P>The <A rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://web.archive.org/web/20151003154544/http://www.valuationtribunal.gov.uk/Home.aspx">Valuation Tribunal Service</A> states that:
</P>
<DL><DD>"The tax is a mix of a property tax and a personal tax. Generally, where two or more persons reside in a dwelling the full tax is payable. If one person resides in the dwelling then 75% is payable. An empty dwelling attracts only a 50% charge unless the billing authority has made a determination otherwise."<SUP id="cite_ref-30" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-30">[30]</A></SUP></DD></DL>
<P>The Council Tax depends on the value of the property, but is not calculated as a simple percentage. Instead, the property is allocated to a Council Tax band, (9 in <A href="/wiki/England" title="England">England</A> and 8 in <A href="/wiki/Scotland" title="Scotland">Scotland</A> and <A href="/wiki/Wales" title="Wales">Wales</A>). Valuation is carried out by the <A rel="nofollow" class="external text" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/valuation-office-agency">Valuation Office Agency</A> under the auspices of Her Majesty's Revenue and Customs (<A href="/wiki/HM_Revenue_and_Customs" title="HM Revenue and Customs">HMRC</A>).<SUP id="cite_ref-31" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-31">[31]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-32" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-32">[32]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="United_States">United States</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Property_tax&action=edit&section=23" title="Edit section: United States">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<DIV role="note" class="hatnote navigation-not-searchable">Main article: <A href="/wiki/Property_tax_in_the_United_States" title="Property tax in the United States">Property tax in the United States</A></DIV>
<P>In the United States, property tax on real estate is usually levied by local government, at the <A href="/wiki/Municipal_government" class="mw-redirect" title="Municipal government">municipal</A> or county level. Rates vary across the states, between about 0% and 4% of the home value.<SUP id="cite_ref-33" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-33">[33]</A></SUP> The assessment is made up of two components—the improvement or building value and the land or site value. The property tax is the main tax supporting local education, police/fire protection, local governments, some free medical services and most of other local infrastructure. Many state and local jurisdictions add personal property taxes.  (See exceptions below.)
</P>

<P>In <A href="/wiki/Alaska" title="Alaska">Alaska</A>, "...only a small portion of the land mass is subject to a property tax. ...only 24 municipalities in Alaska (either cities or boroughs) levy a property tax."<SUP id="cite_ref-42" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-42">[42]</A></SUP>  There is no tax on the private land in <A href="/wiki/American_Samoa" title="American Samoa">American Samoa</A>, the <A href="/wiki/Palmyra_Atoll" title="Palmyra Atoll">Territory of Palmyra Island</A> or <A href="/wiki/Kingman_Reef" title="Kingman Reef">Kingman Reef</A> in the <A href="/wiki/Pacific_Ocean" title="Pacific Ocean">Pacific Ocean</A> <A href="/wiki/Insular_areas" class="mw-redirect" title="Insular areas">insular areas</A>.<SUP id="cite_ref-43" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-43">[43]</A></SUP>

<P><A href="/wiki/Mount_Agung" title="Mount Agung">Mount Agung</A>, a <A href="/wiki/Volcano" title="Volcano">volcano</A> on the island of <A href="/wiki/Bali" title="Bali">Bali</A> in Indonesia, erupted five times in late November 2017, causing thousands to evacuate, disrupting air travel and causing environmental damage. As of  27 November 2017<SUP class="plainlinks noprint asof-tag update" style="display:none;"><A class="external text" href="//en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit">[update]</A></SUP>, the alert level was at its highest and evacuation orders were in place.
</P><P><A href="/wiki/Volcano_tectonic_earthquake" title="Volcano tectonic earthquake">Tectonic earthquakes</A> from the volcano had been detected since early August, and volcanic activity intensified for several weeks before decreasing significantly in late October. A second, more violent period of major activity began in late November.
</P>

<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Background">Background</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: Background">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="1843_eruption">1843 eruption</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: 1843 eruption">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Agung erupted in 1843<SUP id="cite_ref-3" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-3">[3]</A></SUP> as reported by <A href="/wiki/Heinrich_Zollinger" title="Heinrich Zollinger">Heinrich Zollinger</A>:
</P>
<STYLE data-mw-deduplicate="TemplateStyles:r856303468">.mw-parser-output .templatequote{overflow:hidden;margin:1em 0;padding:0 40px}.mw-parser-output .templatequote .templatequotecite{line-height:1.5em;text-align:left;padding-left:1.6em;margin-top:0}</STYLE><BLOCKQUOTE class="templatequote"><P>After having been dormant for a long time, this year the mountain began to be alive again.  In the first days of the activity earthquake shocks were felt after which followed the emission of ash, sand and stones.<SUP id="cite_ref-4" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-4">[4]</A></SUP> 
</P></BLOCKQUOTE>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="1963_eruption">1963 eruption</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section: 1963 eruption">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Mount Agung's 1963 eruption was among the most catastrophic volcanic events in Indonesian history.  After initial explosions in the crater on 18 February of that year, <A href="/wiki/Lava_flows" class="mw-redirect" title="Lava flows">lava</A> began flowing down the mountain on 24 February, eventually traveling 7 km over the next three weeks. On 17 March, a highly explosive eruption occurred, reaching a <A href="/wiki/VEI_5" class="mw-redirect" title="VEI 5">VEI (Volcanic Explosivity Index) of 5</A> and sending lethal <A href="/wiki/Pyroclastic_flows" class="mw-redirect" title="Pyroclastic flows">pyroclastic flows</A> at high speeds down the mountain's slopes, killing at least 1,500 people.<SUP id="cite_ref-:1_5-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-:1-5">[5]</A></SUP> Heavy rainfall mixed with ash from the eruption in the following days caused extensive <A href="/wiki/Lahar" title="Lahar">lahars</A> which killed about 200 more people. A smaller eruption occurred on 16 May, sending pyroclastic flows down the mountain once more, killing about 200 more people.<SUP id="cite_ref-:1_5-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-:1-5">[5]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-BBC27112017_6-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-BBC27112017-6">[6]</A></SUP> By the time the eruptions ceased in early 1964, they had claimed about 1,900 lives, marking the event as the <A href="/wiki/List_of_volcanic_eruptions_by_death_toll" title="List of volcanic eruptions by death toll">8th deadliest volcanic eruption of the 20th century</A>.
</P><P>Since 1963, the population of Bali has nearly doubled.<SUP id="cite_ref-7" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-7">[7]</A></SUP> Mount Agung is therefore considered highly dangerous by Indonesian authorities. This concern was the primary reason behind their decision to evacuate more than 100,000 people in response to the surge in local tectonic activity in the latter half of 2017.<SUP id="cite_ref-BBC27112017_6-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-BBC27112017-6">[6]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Major_activity_in_2017">Major activity in 2017</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section: Major activity in 2017">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="August">August</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section: August">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P><A href="/wiki/Volcano_tectonic_earthquake" title="Volcano tectonic earthquake">Volcanic earthquakes</A> were observed from 10 August 2017<SUP id="cite_ref-WVAR_19sep_8-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-WVAR_19sep-8">[8]</A></SUP> and the intensity increased in the following weeks.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="September">September</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section: September">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>In September 2017, an increase of rumbling and seismic activity around the volcano made people raise the alert to the highest level and about 122,500 people were evacuated from their homes around the volcano.<SUP id="cite_ref-9" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-9">[9]</A></SUP> The <A href="/wiki/Indonesian_National_Board_for_Disaster_Management" title="Indonesian National Board for Disaster Management">Indonesian National Disaster Management Authority</A> declared a 12-kilometer exclusion zone around the volcano on 24 September.<SUP id="cite_ref-10" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-10">[10]</A></SUP> A plume was observed on 13 September.<SUP id="cite_ref-WVAR_19sep_8-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-WVAR_19sep-8">[8]</A></SUP>
</P><P>Evacuees gathered in sports halls and other community buildings around <A href="/wiki/Klungkung" class="mw-redirect" title="Klungkung">Klungkung</A>, <A href="/wiki/Karangasem_Regency" title="Karangasem Regency">Karangasem</A>, <A href="/wiki/Buleleng" class="mw-redirect" title="Buleleng">Buleleng</A>, and other areas.<SUP id="cite_ref-11" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-11">[11]</A></SUP> The monitoring station is in Tembuku, Rendang, Karangasem Regency, where intensity and frequency of tremors were monitored for signs of the imminent large eruption.<SUP id="cite_ref-12" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-12">[12]</A></SUP>
</P><P>The area experienced 844 volcanic earthquakes on 25 September, and 300 to 400 earthquakes by midday on 26 September. Seismologists have been alarmed at the force and frequency of the incidents as it has taken much less for similar volcanoes to erupt.<SUP id="cite_ref-cna-Agung_13-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-cna-Agung-13">[13]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-14" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-14">[14]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="October">October</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=7" title="Edit section: October">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>In late October 2017, the activity of the volcano decreased significantly, leading to lowering of the alert status on 29 October.<SUP id="cite_ref-SMH_oct_15-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-SMH_oct-15">[15]</A></SUP>
</P><P>The alert level remained at 3 (out of 4) until the start of the second major activity period, and plumes were observed during this time.<SUP id="cite_ref-WVAR_7nov_16-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-WVAR_7nov-16">[16]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-WVAR_14nov_17-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-WVAR_14nov-17">[17]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="November">November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=8" title="Edit section: November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="21_November">21 November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section: 21 November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>There was a small <A href="/wiki/Phreatic_eruption" title="Phreatic eruption">phreatic eruption</A> reported at 09:05 (<A href="/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time" title="Coordinated Universal Time">UTC</A>), with the <A href="/wiki/Ash_cloud" class="mw-redirect" title="Ash cloud">ash cloud</A> top reaching 3,842 metres (12,605 ft) above sea level.<SUP id="cite_ref-18" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-18">[18]</A></SUP> Thousands of people immediately fled the area,<SUP id="cite_ref-19" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-19">[19]</A></SUP> and over 29,000 temporary refugees were reported to be housed in over 270 locations nearby.<SUP id="cite_ref-20" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-20">[20]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="25_November">25 November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=10" title="Edit section: 25 November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>A <A href="/wiki/Magma" title="Magma">magmatic</A> eruption began early on Saturday morning.<SUP id="cite_ref-vd-25-11-17_21-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-vd-25-11-17-21">[21]</A></SUP> The resulting eruption <A href="/wiki/Eruption_column" title="Eruption column">plume</A> was reported to rise about 1.5–4 km above the summit crater, drifting towards the south and dusting the surroundings with a thin layer of dark ash, leading some airlines to cancel flights bound for Australia and New Zealand. An orange glow was later observed around the crater at night, confirming that fresh magma had indeed reached the surface.<SUP id="cite_ref-22" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-22">[22]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-23" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-23">[23]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="26_November">26 November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=11" title="Edit section: 26 November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<P>At 23:37 (UTC), another eruption occurred.<SUP id="cite_ref-vd-25-11-17_21-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-vd-25-11-17-21">[21]</A></SUP> <A href="/wiki/Ngurah_Rai_International_Airport" title="Ngurah Rai International Airport">Ngurah Rai International Airport</A> was closed next day,<SUP id="cite_ref-24" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-24">[24]</A></SUP> leaving many tourists stranded.<SUP id="cite_ref-Viva981801_25-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-Viva981801-25">[25]</A></SUP> More than 100,000 people in a 10-kilometre (6.2 mi) radius of the volcano were ordered to evacuate.<SUP id="cite_ref-BBC42132912_26-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-BBC42132912-26">[26]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="27_November">27 November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=12" title="Edit section: 27 November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<DIV class="thumb tright"><DIV class="thumbinner" style="width:222px;"><A href="/wiki/File:Mount_Agung,_November_2017_eruption_-_27_Nov_2017_01.jpg" class="image"><IMG alt="" height="165" class="thumbimage" title="Enlarge"></A></DIV>Ash plume from Mount Agung on 27 November</DIV></DIV></DIV><P> Sunday 26 November's eruption continued at a constant rate,<SUP id="cite_ref-:0_27-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-:0-27">[27]</A></SUP> and <A href="/wiki/Lahar" title="Lahar">lahars</A> were reported in the <A href="/wiki/Karangasem_Regency" title="Karangasem Regency">Selat district</A> south of the volcano.<SUP id="cite_ref-Viva981801_25-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-Viva981801-25">[25]</A></SUP> The Australian Government's Bureau of Meteorology reported that the top of the eruption column had reached an altitude of 9,144 m (5.7 miles).<SUP id="cite_ref-28" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-28">[28]</A></SUP> Ash continued to spread in a southeasterly direction, and estimates by the <A href="/wiki/Pacific_Disaster_Center" title="Pacific Disaster Center">Pacific Disaster Center</A> predicted that the resulting atmospheric ash exposure will affect up to 5.6 million people within the densely populated region surrounding the volcano.<SUP id="cite_ref-:0_27-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-:0-27">[27]</A></SUP>
</P><H4><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="29_November">29 November</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=13" title="Edit section: 29 November">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H4>
<DIV class="thumb tright"><DIV class="thumbinner" style="width:222px;"><A href="/wiki/File:NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg" class="image"><IMG alt="" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg/220px-NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg" width="220" height="212" class="thumbimage" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg/330px-NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg 1.5x, //upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg/440px-NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg 2x" data-file-width="1302" data-file-height="1256" /></A>  <DIV class="thumbcaption"><DIV class="magnify"><A href="/wiki/File:NASA_MODIS_aerial_view_of_Agung_ash_2017.jpg" class="internal" title="Enlarge"></A></DIV>NASA MODIS aerial view of ash from Terra satellite.</DIV></DIV></DIV>
<P>Reductions in eruption intensity and wind dispersal of the ash cloud led authorities to reopen <A href="/wiki/Ngurah_Rai_International_Airport" title="Ngurah Rai International Airport">Ngurah Rai International Airport</A> at 07:00 (UTC).<SUP id="cite_ref-29" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-29">[29]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-eveningstandard_30-0" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-eveningstandard-30">[30]</A></SUP> Authorities also warned that the eruption volume could increase again at any time, potentially shutting down air traffic once more.<SUP id="cite_ref-eveningstandard_30-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-eveningstandard-30">[30]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Activity_in_2018">Activity in 2018</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=14" title="Edit section: Activity in 2018">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="January">January</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=15" title="Edit section: January">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>The volcano erupted once again on January 11, sending plumes of smoke and ash, while Indonesia's Bali international airport was declared safe, operating normally.<SUP id="cite_ref-31" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-31">[31]</A></SUP> The eruption column was reported to rise 2.5 km above the mountain.
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="June">June</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=16" title="Edit section: June">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Agung erupted on June 12, sending plumes of smoke and ash some 2,000 meters above the volcano's summit.<SUP id="cite_ref-32" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-32">[32]</A></SUP> No flights were affected from the event.
</P><P>On June 28, water vapour and volcanic ash emission were detected from Mount Agung up to two kilometres into the air. The Ngurah Rai Airport was closed due to the event. <SUP id="cite_ref-33" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-33">[33]</A></SUP><SUP id="cite_ref-34" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-34">[34]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H3><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="July">July</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=17" title="Edit section: July">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H3>
<P>Agung erupted again July 3 due to a minor strombolian explosion. 700 people living near the crater were evacuated. No flights were affected.<SUP id="cite_ref-35" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-35">[35]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Impact">Impact</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=2017%E2%80%932018_eruptions_of_Mount_Agung&action=edit&section=18" title="Edit section: Impact">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<P>The 2017 eruption caused some 40,000 people to be evacuated from 22 villages around Mount Agung. It also caused surrounding airports to be closed. <A href="/wiki/Lombok_International_Airport" title="Lombok International Airport">Lombok International Airport</A>, on the neighboring island of <A href="/wiki/Lombok" title="Lombok">Lombok</A>, closed on 26 November, but was reopened the next morning,<SUP id="cite_ref-36" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-36">[36]</A></SUP> only to be closed again on 30 November.<SUP id="cite_ref-37" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-37">[37]</A></SUP> Lombok's airport reopened on 1 December. <A href="/wiki/Ngurah_Rai_International_Airport" title="Ngurah Rai International Airport">Ngurah Rai International Airport</A>, located at the southern tip of the island and southwest of the volcano, closed on 27 November.<SUP id="cite_ref-38" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-38">[38]</A></SUP> More than 400 flights were canceled and about 59,000 passengers remained grounded.<SUP id="cite_ref-39" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-39">[39]</A></SUP> The airport was reopened on 29 November. This eruption also caused a decline in tourism on Bali by about 30%.
</P>

<H1 id="firstHeading" class="firstHeading" lang="en">Income elasticity of demand</H1>			<DIV id="bodyContent" class="mw-body-content">
				<DIV id="siteSub" class="noprint">From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia</DIV>				<DIV id="contentSub"></DIV>
				<DIV id="jump-to-nav"></DIV>				<A class="mw-jump-link" href="#mw-head">Jump to navigation</A>
				<A class="mw-jump-link" href="#p-search">Jump to search</A>
				<DIV id="mw-content-text" lang="en" dir="ltr" class="mw-content-ltr"><DIV class="mw-parser-output"><P>In economics, <B>income elasticity of demand</B> measures the responsiveness of the quantity demanded for a good or service to a change in the income of the people demanding the good. It is calculated as the ratio of the percentage change in quantity demanded to the percentage change in income. For example, if in response to a 10% increase in income, the quantity demanded for a good increased by 20%, the income elasticity of demand would be 20%/10% = 2.0
</P>

<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Interpretation">Interpretation</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Income_elasticity_of_demand&action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section: Interpretation">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>
<DIV class="thumb tright"><DIV class="thumbinner" style="width:222px;"><A href="/wiki/File:Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg" class="image"><IMG alt="" src="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg/220px-Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg.png" width="220" height="148" class="thumbimage" srcset="//upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg/330px-Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg.png 1.5x, //upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/8/83/Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg/440px-Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg.png 2x" data-file-width="512" data-file-height="344" /></A>  <DIV class="thumbcaption"><DIV class="magnify"><A href="/wiki/File:Income_elasticity_of_demand_-_inferior_goods.svg" class="internal" title="Enlarge"></A></DIV><A href="/wiki/Inferior_good" title="Inferior good">Inferior goods</A>' demand falls as consumer income increases.</DIV></DIV></DIV>
<UL><LI>A negative  income elasticity of demand is associated with <A href="/wiki/Inferior_good" title="Inferior good">inferior goods</A>; an increase in income will lead to a fall in the demand and may lead to changes to more luxurious substitutes.</LI>
<LI>A positive income elasticity of demand is associated with <A href="/wiki/Normal_good" title="Normal good">normal goods</A>; an increase in income will lead to a rise in demand. If income elasticity of demand of a commodity is less than 1, it is a <A href="/wiki/Necessity_good" title="Necessity good">necessity good</A>. If the elasticity of demand is greater than 1, it is a <A href="/wiki/Luxury_good" class="mw-redirect" title="Luxury good">luxury good</A> or a <A href="/wiki/Superior_good" title="Superior good">superior good</A>.</LI>
<LI>A zero income elasticity of demand occurs when an increase in income is not associated with a change in the demand of a good. These would be sticky goods.</LI></UL>
<P>Income elasticity of demand can be used as an indicator of industry health, future consumption patterns and as a guide to firms investment decisions. For example, the "selected income elasticities" below suggest that an increasing portion of consumer's budgets will be devoted to purchasing automobiles and restaurant meals and a smaller share to tobacco and margarine.<SUP id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-1">[1]</A></SUP>
</P><P>Income elasticities are closely related to the population income distribution and the fraction of the product's sales attributable to buyers from different <A href="/wiki/Income_bracket" title="Income bracket">income brackets</A>.  Specifically when a buyer in a certain income bracket experiences an income increase,  their purchase of a product changes to match that of individuals  in their new income bracket.  If the income share elasticity is defined as the negative percentage change in individuals given a percentage increase in income bracken the income-elasticity, after some computation, becomes the expected value of the income-share elasticity with respect to the income distribution of purchasers of the product.  When the income distribution is described by a <A href="/wiki/Gamma_distribution" title="Gamma distribution">gamma distribution</A>, the income elasticity is proportional to the percentage difference between the average income of the product's buyers and the average income of the population.<SUP id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><A href="#cite_note-2">[2]</A></SUP>
</P>
<H2><SPAN class="mw-headline" id="Mathematical_definition">Mathematical definition</SPAN><SPAN class="mw-editsection"><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</SPAN><A href="/w/index.php?title=Income_elasticity_of_demand&action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section: Mathematical definition">edit</A><SPAN class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</SPAN></SPAN></H2>

<P>This can be rewritten in the form:

<P>With income <SPAN class="mwe-math-element"><SPAN class="mwe-math-mathml-inline mwe-math-mathml-a11y" style="display: none;"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" alttext="{\displaystyle I}">
